policy_statement: Helsinki will become carbon-neutral by 2035 by reducing greenhouse gas emissions by 80% from 1990 levels and compensating the remaining 20% through emissions reductions outside the city.
source_quote: According to the Strategy, Helsinki will be carbon-neutral by 2035. This goal will be achieved by reducing the greenhouse gas emissions in Helsinki by 80 per cent. The remaining 20 per cent will be compensated for by Helsinki taking care of implementing emissions reductions outside the city.
extraction_rationale: This is the overarching quantified climate target of the plan, with a deadline and compensation mechanism.

policy_statement: Helsinki will reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 60% from 1990 levels by 2030 as an intermediate target.
source_quote: The City Strategy also includes an intermediate goal for 2030: greenhouse gas emissions will be reduced by 60 per cent during 1990-2030.
extraction_rationale: This is a quantified interim emissions-reduction target with a specific deadline.

policy_statement: Helsinki will reduce traffic emissions by 69% from 2005 levels by 2035.
source_quote: Helsinki's carbon-neutrality objective (emissions reduction of 80 % in 1990-2035) has been set in such a way that the emissions from traffic must be reduced by 69 per cent from 2005 to 2035.
extraction_rationale: This is a sector-specific quantified mitigation target for transport emissions.

policy_statement: Helsinki will pursue an 82% emissions reduction for the energy use of buildings during 1990-2035.
source_quote: The emissions reduction goal for the energy use of buildings is 82 per cent during 19902035. The goal can be feasibly reached, but it will require a rapid and large-scale start for the actions.
section_header: Emission reductions of construction and use of buildings
extraction_rationale: This is a quantified sectoral emissions target for buildings.

parent_statement: Key actions related to modes of transport
policy_statement: Improve services and smooth connections at traffic nodes by implementing HSL Solmu and park-and-ride plans and increasing signposts and mobile applications.
source_quote: 1. The services offered in traffic nodes and the smoothness of the traffic connections will be improved. The action plan devised in connection with HSL's Solmu project will be implemented.
extraction_rationale: Numbered transport action with named interventions to improve multimodal travel chains.

parent_statement: Key actions related to modes of transport
policy_statement: Complete the target network for bicycle traffic in the inner city by 2025.
source_quote: 2. The target network for bicycle traffic in the inner city will be completed by 2025. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Traffic and Street Planning.
extraction_rationale: Specific infrastructure target with a deadline that supports low-emission transport.

parent_statement: Key actions related to modes of transport
policy_statement: Complete the Baana bicycle traffic network by 2030.
source_quote: 3. The Baana network for bicycle traffic will be completed by 2030. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Traffic and Street Planning.
extraction_rationale: Specific cycling infrastructure target with deadline.

parent_statement: Key actions related to modes of transport
policy_statement: Expand the cycling lane network with high-level winter maintenance.
source_quote: 4. The cycling lane network with high-level winter maintenance will be expanded. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Traffic and Street Planning, Buildings and Public Areas / Maintenance.
extraction_rationale: Operational commitment to expand cycling infrastructure maintenance.

parent_statement: Key actions related to modes of transport
policy_statement: Promote a pleasant and safe pedestrian environment, including through the traffic safety development programme.
source_quote: 5. A pleasant and safe environment for pedestrians will be promoted, for example by implementing the development programme for traffic safety. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Detailed Planning, Land Use and City Structure / Traffic and Street Planning.
extraction_rationale: Specific pedestrian and traffic-safety intervention to support modal shift.

parent_statement: Key actions related to modes of transport
policy_statement: Develop cycling services, communications, bicycle carriage on heavy rail, and related capacity.
source_quote: 6. Services for bicycling (city bikes, bike hubs, bike parking, etc.) and the related communications will be developed. The ability to carry bicycles in heavy train traffic will be developed and the capacity for this will be increased.
extraction_rationale: Specific service and capacity interventions for cycling integration with public transport.

parent_statement: Key actions related to modes of transport
policy_statement: Implement Helsinki's tram traffic development programme and meet objectives for tram speed, flow, reliability and disturbance level.
source_quote: 7. The development programme for tram traffic in Helsinki will be implemented. The objectives for the speed, flow, reliability and disturbance level of tram traffic will be achieved.
extraction_rationale: Named programme implementation to improve low-emission public transport.

parent_statement: Key actions related to modes of transport
policy_statement: Improve public transport service levels and rail network coverage through land-use coordination and trunk network strengthening.
source_quote: 8. The service level of public transport and the coverage of the rail network will be improved. By ensuring sufficient passenger demand through simultaneous planning of land use and traffic investments (such as complementary construction).
extraction_rationale: Specific public transport service and network improvement action.

parent_statement: Key actions related to modes of transport
policy_statement: Implement the cycling promotion programme and bicycle parking development programme.
source_quote: 9. The promotion programme for cycling and the development programme for bicycle parking will be implemented. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Traffic and Street Planning, HSL, HKL.
extraction_rationale: Named programme implementation for cycling mode shift.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the pricing of transport
policy_statement: Prepare for and potentially trial a pricing system for vehicle traffic, such as a road toll or congestion tax, with revenue allocated to regional transport development.
source_quote: 10. A pricing system for vehicle traffic (a road toll or congestion tax): Necessary additional surveys conducted primarily together with the State and the municipalities in the region, helping the City prepare for the start of the trial. The requirement for the pricing is that the income from road tolls be allocated for the development of the region's transport system.
extraction_rationale: A road toll or congestion tax is a financial instrument intended to reduce transport emissions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the pricing of transport
policy_statement: Continue current parking policy until 2021 and then further raise parking fees to reduce CO2 emissions after studying business impacts.
source_quote: 11. The current parking policy will continue until 2021 and, afterwards, the parking fees will be raised further to reduce CO2 emissions. The impact on business will be studied before making the decision.
extraction_rationale: Parking fee increases are a financial instrument explicitly tied to CO2 reduction.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the pricing of transport
policy_statement: Scale parking fees more strongly based on emissions and promotion of joint vehicle use.
source_quote: 12. Parking fees will be scaled more heavily from the perspective of emissions and the promotion of the joint use of vehicles. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Traffic and Street Planning, Services and Permits / Environmental Services, Executive Office.
extraction_rationale: Emission-based parking pricing is a financial instrument for transport emissions reduction.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the pricing of transport
policy_statement: Expand parking fee zones.
source_quote: 13. The parking fee zones will be expanded. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Traffic and Street Planning.
extraction_rationale: Expanding paid parking zones is a pricing measure intended to reduce car use.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the growing city structure
policy_statement: Promote public transport and other sustainable travel by complementing and densifying the city structure.
source_quote: 14. The use of public transport and other sustainable means of travel will be promoted by complementing the community structure of the City. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Traffic and Street Planning, Land Use and City Structure / Detailed Planning.
extraction_rationale: Land-use planning intervention to reduce transport emissions through accessibility and modal shift.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the growing city structure
policy_statement: Update parking norms to better support sustainable transport in new areas and complementary construction.
source_quote: 15. The parking norms will be updated to better support sustainable transport both in the design of new areas and in the complementary construction of existing areas. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Detailed Planning.
extraction_rationale: Regulatory/planning change targeting reduced car dependence.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the growing city structure
policy_statement: Encourage bicycle- and pedestrian-focused blocks and areas through land use planning.
source_quote: 16. The creation of blocks and areas that focus on bicycle and pedestrian traffic will be encouraged through land use planning. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Detailed Planning, Land Use and City Structure / Traffic and Street Planning.
extraction_rationale: Specific land-use planning intervention for low-emission travel.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the changes in vehicle technology
policy_statement: Develop the environmental zone by assessing expansion, adding CO2 criteria and preparing a CO2-based environmental zone for introduction.
source_quote: 17. The environmental zone will be developed: Assessments will be carried out for expanding the current environmental zone, including CO2 emissions in the criteria and applying the requirements to different types of vehicles (council term 20172021). A CO2 emissions based environmental zone will be ready for introduction based on the assessment.
extraction_rationale: Regulatory transport zone with explicit CO2 criteria.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the changes in vehicle technology
policy_statement: Enable market-based construction of public electric car charging infrastructure according to electric traffic working group recommendations.
source_quote: 18. Market-based construction of public charging infrastructure for electric cars will be made possible. Implemented as per the recommendations of the electric traffic working group.
extraction_rationale: Specific enabling action for electric vehicle infrastructure.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the changes in vehicle technology
policy_statement: Develop and tighten environmental criteria in procurement of delivery, heavy delivery, utility vehicle, machinery and related contract services, and monitor compliance.
source_quote: 19. The City of Helsinki will develop and tighten the environmental criteria (incl. alternative fuel sources, emission classes) in all competitive bidding processes for delivery services, heavy delivery services and utility vehicle and machinery services, as well as in competitive bidding processes for contract work including any of the above-mentioned services. Once the procurement process is completed, the client will monitor the environmental criteria.
extraction_rationale: Procurement criteria are binding operational requirements for lower-emission fleets.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the changes in vehicle technology
policy_statement: Apply environmental criteria to City-owned and leased vehicles, and require Stara and HKL fleets to use only biofuels or renewable electricity by 2020.
source_quote: 20. The environmental criteria will be applied to procurement of the City's own vehicles and leasing vehicles. The fleets of Stara and HKL will only use vehicles that run on biofuels or renewable electricity by 2020.
extraction_rationale: Specific procurement and fleet fuel requirement with a deadline.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the changes in vehicle technology
policy_statement: Develop city logistics and incentives for low-emission delivery traffic, including environmental criteria-based parking ID pricing and loading networks.
source_quote: 21. The City of Helsinki will have an active role in developing city logistics and incentives to encourage low-emissions delivery traffic. The introduction of a parking ID system for delivery traffic, implementing environmental criteria-based price categories for the parking ID system and expanding the network of loading and unloading points for delivery traffic will be researched.
extraction_rationale: Specific logistics and pricing-incentive measures for low-emission freight.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the changes in vehicle technology
policy_statement: HSL will operate 10% of ordered bus traffic with electric buses by 2022, 30% by 2025, and 90% of ordered traffic with biofuels by 2020.
source_quote: 22. HSL will continue to pursue its objectives; for example, 10 % of the bus traffic ordered by HSL will be operated using electric buses by 2022, with an increase to 30 % by 2025; and 90 % of the traffic ordered by HSL will be run on biofuels (renewable next-generation biodiesel and biogas) by 2020.
extraction_rationale: Quantified low-emission public transport fleet targets with deadlines.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the changes in vehicle technology
policy_statement: Expand bus charging infrastructure through the bus traffic competitive bidding programme.
source_quote: 23. The charging infrastructure for buses will be expanded as part of the bus traffic competitive bidding programme. Parties responsible: HSL, HKL, Helen and Helen Electricity Networks.
extraction_rationale: Specific infrastructure action enabling electric buses.

parent_statement: Key actions related to reducing the emissions from the Port operations
policy_statement: The Port of Helsinki will create a Carbon-neutral Port by 2035 Action Plan including energy reviews, shore power, fleet criteria, low-emission fuels, environmental incentives and enabling low-emission ships.
source_quote: 24. The Port of Helsinki will create the Carbon-neutral Port by 2035 Action Plan which will include the following types of actions: Energy reviews performed every four years in accordance with the legislation on energy efficiency. Advancing the use of shore power with requirement outlines and increasing the number of shore power connections, if necessary.
section_header: 4.1.5 Reducing the emissions from the harbours
extraction_rationale: Named harbour decarbonisation programme with specified interventions and 2035 target.

parent_statement: Key actions related to reducing the emissions from the Port operations
policy_statement: Smooth West Harbour traffic between the harbour and Länsiväylä.
source_quote: 25. The traffic of the West Harbour will be made smoother between the Harbour and the Länsiväylä. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Traffic and Street Planning, Executive Office / Area construction, Executive Office / Economic Development and The Port of Helsinki Ltd.
section_header: 4.1.5 Reducing the emissions from the harbours
extraction_rationale: Traffic-flow intervention for harbour-related transport efficiency; climate link is indirect but included in emissions actions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new mobility services and the steering of mobility
policy_statement: Act as a testing platform for smart mobility services and adopt functional solutions.
source_quote: 26. The City will act as a testing platform for smart mobility services and adopt more functional solutions. Parties responsible: Urban Environment Division + other divisions, Land Use and City Structure / Traffic and Street Planning, Executive Office / Economic Development, HSL, HKL, Forum Virium, Services and Permits / Environmental Services, S&C Foundation.
section_header: 4.1.6 New mobility services and steering of mobility
extraction_rationale: Specific test-platform intervention for low-carbon mobility services.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new mobility services and the steering of mobility
policy_statement: Support introduction of mobility services through open data, ride-sharing allocation studies, additional measures and City-paid rides integration.
source_quote: 27. The City will support the introduction of different mobility services: Continuing to make data more open and developing the marketing of open data. Examining the allocation of ride-sharing services for areas with a low public transport service level.
section_header: 4.1.6 New mobility services and steering of mobility
extraction_rationale: Operational support for shared and smart mobility services intended to reduce transport emissions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new mobility services and the steering of mobility
policy_statement: Prepare a Smart Transport in Helsinki Action Plan updating the 2013 plan.
source_quote: 28. The Smart Transport in Helsinki Action Plan will be prepared (update to the Action Plan decided on in 2013). Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Traffic and Street Planning.
section_header: 4.1.6 New mobility services and steering of mobility
extraction_rationale: Named planning commitment for smart transport emissions reduction.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new mobility services and the steering of mobility
policy_statement: Campaign and communicate to promote sustainable transport modes.
source_quote: 29. The City will campaign and communicate to promote sustainable means of transport. Parties responsible: Urban Environment Division / communications, HSL.
section_header: 4.1.6 New mobility services and steering of mobility
extraction_rationale: Behaviour-change communication action supporting low-emission transport.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new mobility services and the steering of mobility
policy_statement: Implement mobility plans and smart transport plans for the City organisation, subsidiaries and companies, and survey company needs to reduce and improve traffic efficiency.
source_quote: 30. Mobility plans and other smart transport plans will be implemented for the City organisation, subsidiary communities and companies. The City and HSL, together with entrepreneurs, will survey the needs of companies and the opportunities for reducing traffic and making it more efficient.
section_header: 4.1.6 New mobility services and steering of mobility
extraction_rationale: Specific organisational mobility-management plans to reduce travel emissions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Review recent energy survey actions, project feasible unimplemented measures and improve documentation.
source_quote: 31. The status of the actions identified in the energy surveys of the last years will be examined and both the unimplemented and feasible actions will be projected. The documentation of the survey implementation will also be developed.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific energy-management action for municipal buildings.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Identify major heat-loss sources and heat recovery opportunities in City service buildings and implement viable projects.
source_quote: 32. The most significant sources of heat loss in the City's service building stock (in particular, sports halls and apartment buildings) and the opportunities for heat recovery will be identified. The viable projects will be implemented.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific heat recovery and efficiency intervention.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Allocate energy consumption and savings costs more effectively to facility users, maintainers and other actors to encourage conservation.
source_quote: 33. The cost effects of energy consumption and energy savings will be better allocated for the actors affecting the energy consumption of facilities. We will attempt to develop a method that encourages all actors to conserve energy.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Operational incentive/accounting reform to reduce building energy use.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Develop office building consumption monitoring into energy-efficiency monitoring by adding building condition and usage data.
source_quote: 34. The consumption monitoring of office buildings will be developed towards the monitoring of energy- efficiency by adding the condition and usage data of the buildings into the energy consumption data. All properties owned by the City or that offer City services will be connected to the new monitoring system.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific monitoring system intervention to improve energy efficiency.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Pilot electricity and heating demand response in City premises, assess potential and investment needs, and prepare adoption plans.
source_quote: 35. Demand response of electricity and heating will be piloted in the City's premises in different types of service building. Based on the pilots, the potential of demand response in the premises and the need for investments will be estimated, and a plan will be made for the extent and schedule of the adoption of these changes.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific energy demand-response pilot and scaling plan.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Examine property-specific or regional energy storage opportunities and prepare objectives and an operating plan for storage use.
source_quote: 36. Property-specific or regional opportunities for storing energy (electricity and heat) will be examined, as will the cost effects of these opportunities. Based on the results, objectives will be set for using the storage to increase the demand response level and as reserve power, and an operating plan will be prepared.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific planning and operational action for energy storage and demand response.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Prepare and monitor a target programme for using renewable energy in City construction projects and existing buildings.
source_quote: 37. A target programme for using renewable energy in the City's construction projects and existing buildings will be prepared, and the progress of the programme will be monitored. Parties responsible: Buildings and Public Areas / Built Assets Management, in collaboration with Helen.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Named renewable energy programme for City buildings.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Develop construction and maintenance procurement criteria to incorporate energy efficiency, lifecycle CO2 emissions and environmental impacts.
source_quote: 38. The City will constantly develop its criteria and methods for procurements in construction and maintenance so that they will take City's ambitious goals into account in terms of things such as energy efficiency, lifecycle CO2 emissions and environmental impacts.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Procurement policy with explicit energy efficiency and lifecycle CO2 criteria.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Strengthen competence and commitment of construction and maintenance actors on low emissions, energy efficiency, lifecycle impacts and procurement criteria.
source_quote: 39. The commitment and competence of the actors responsible for construction and maintenance will be strengthened in terms of the low emission levels, energy efficiency and lifecycle impacts of the construction projects and existing buildings and in terms of the environmental criteria used in procurements.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Capacity-building commitment directly tied to emissions and energy efficiency implementation.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Set policies, objectives and procedures for resolving facility-project conflicts involving energy efficiency, renewable energy, costs and heritage values.
source_quote: 40. Policies, objectives and procedures will be set for facility projects with conflicting interests related to energy efficiency and the utilisation of renewable energy, i.e. costs, profitability, protection values, architectonic solutions and the cityscape.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Governance procedure to enable energy efficiency and renewable energy in City projects.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Develop project planning and cost calculations so maximum project prices do not block cost-efficient energy and emissions-reduction solutions.
source_quote: 41. The project planning and cost calculations for facility projects will be developed from the perspective of energy efficiency and emissions reductions to ensure that the maximum prices set in project decisions will not impede the implementation of cost-efficient solutions.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Process reform to facilitate energy efficiency and emissions reductions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Minimise lifecycle emissions from City construction and infrastructure projects through tools, reporting, emissions objectives, procurement criteria and pilots.
source_quote: 42. The lifecycle emissions from the City's construction and infrastructure projects will be minimised. An emissions reduction objective and procurement criteria will be set for the lifecycle emissions of buildings and infrastructure projects, categorised by the project type.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Direct commitment to minimise lifecycle emissions with quantified/project criteria to be developed.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the service buildings of the City
policy_statement: Pilot energy-plus construction and prepare a phased plan for moving toward energy-plus construction.
source_quote: 43. The City will pilot energy-plus construction, examine the cost effects and challenges of such construction, and, based on the former, prepare a plan for moving gradually towards energy-plus construction while discussing the matter with innovative actors in the construction industry.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific building pilot and transition plan for positive-energy buildings.

parent_statement: Key actions related to circular economy in construction projects
policy_statement: Identify obstacles and opportunities for increasing recycled material use in housing, infrastructure and maintenance, and prepare actions and instructions.
source_quote: 44. The obstacles and opportunities related to increasing the proportion of recycled materials in housing construction, infrastructural construction and maintenance. Actions and instructions for this will be prepared.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Circular construction resource-use intervention; wording is slightly elliptical due OCR but clear enough.

parent_statement: Key actions related to circular economy in construction projects
policy_statement: Implement principles and an action plan for using excavated earth, rock and demolition material in groundwork, and participate in a regional landmass tool.
source_quote: 45. The principles of using excavated earth, rock material and demolition material in groundwork and the related action plan (2018-2021) will be put into practice as a part of the procedures following the resource planning system. The City will participate in the development and adoption of the regional landmass tool using geographical information (SeutuMaisa).
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific circular-economy construction material reuse action.

parent_statement: Key actions related to circular economy in construction projects
policy_statement: Pilot emission-free construction sites in City projects and adopt a model and criteria for all sites based on pilot experience.
source_quote: 46. Emission-free construction sites will be piloted in the City's own construction projects, and a model and criteria for all sites will be adopted based on the experiences from the pilot. The model and the criteria will be included in the environmental document for infrastructure and housing construction projects, as well as in the environmental plan of the site.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific pilot and standards adoption for emission-free construction sites.

parent_statement: Key actions related to City-owned residential buildings
policy_statement: Implement exhaust-air and sewage heat recovery solutions in renovations and economically viable EAHP projects.
source_quote: 47. Solutions for the recovery of the heat from exhaust air and sewage will be implemented: locations being renovated will use either mechanical input and removal with heat recovery or an EAHP. EAHP projects will be implemented without renovations in buildings where it is economically viable (repayment period of under 15 years).
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific heat recovery requirement with economic threshold.

parent_statement: Key actions related to City-owned residential buildings
policy_statement: Seek high energy efficiency in renovations of City housing and implement viable lifecycle-cost energy efficiency measures.
source_quote: 48. Great energy efficiency will be sought in the renovations of the City's own housing production, and actions for making the buildings more energy efficient will be implemented where they are viable in terms of lifecycle costs.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Energy-efficiency renovation commitment for City-owned housing.

parent_statement: Key actions related to City-owned residential buildings
policy_statement: Plan and implement energy efficiency renovations and measures through long-term maintenance plans, including water consumption reduction and heat exchanger adjustments.
source_quote: 49. The renovations and separate measures for improving energy efficiency will be planned and implemented according to the long-term maintenance plans. The plan must also include annual maintenance and repair-type measures (heat exchangers, adjustments to radiator valves, reduction of water consumption).
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific planning requirement for recurring energy and water efficiency measures.

parent_statement: Key actions related to City-owned residential buildings
policy_statement: Upgrade Heka's old property automation systems to improve energy efficiency and enable remote water consumption reading with HSY.
source_quote: 50. Heka's old property automation systems will be upgraded to improve energy efficiency. Remote reading and measuring of water consumption will be made possible in collaboration with HSY.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific building automation and metering intervention for energy and water efficiency.

parent_statement: Key actions related to City-owned residential buildings
policy_statement: Investigate renewable energy use in City and subsidiary building stock and prepare a scheduled implementation plan for cost-efficient local heat and electricity production.
source_quote: 51. The City will investigate the utilisation of renewable energy in its own building stock and that of its subsidiaries. The objective is to find cost-efficient (repayment period of 10-15 years) targets to be repaired in terms of local heating and electricity production.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Renewable energy deployment planning for municipal building stock.

parent_statement: Key actions related to City-owned residential buildings
policy_statement: Heka will pilot geothermal and marine heating and expand their use based on experience.
source_quote: 52. Heka will pilot the use of geothermal/marine heating and expand the use thereof based on the experiences. Parties responsible: Heka Housing, in collaboration with Helen.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific renewable heat pilot and scale-up commitment.

parent_statement: Key actions related to City-owned residential buildings
policy_statement: Prepare renovation support guidelines and technical concept solutions including energy conservation targets, renewables, heat recovery and demolition assessment.
source_quote: 53. General and common guidelines to support renovations will be prepared. The concept solution will include the following, in addition to the technical renovation solutions: Target level for energy conservation or the E value; Adoption of renewable energy, such as solar panels; The implementation measures for heat recovery from ventilation and sewage.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Guidance and standard concepts to embed efficiency and renewables into renovation.

parent_statement: Key actions related to outdoor lighting
policy_statement: Upgrade street lighting to LED light sources according to plan and use smart lighting control.
source_quote: 54. The City will upgrade street lighting to use LED light sources, according to plan, and also use smart lighting control. Parties responsible: Buildings and Public Areas / Maintenance, Built Assets Management.
section_header: 4.2.1 Residential and service buildings and outdoor lighting owned by the City
extraction_rationale: Specific energy-efficiency retrofit for public lighting.

parent_statement: Key actions related to detailed planning
policy_statement: Use detailed planning to promote renewable energy and meaningful property-specific, regional and centralised renewable energy production, including wind power principles and pilots.
source_quote: 55. Detailed planning will be used to promote the use of renewable energy and property-specific, regional and centralised production of renewable energy in a meaningful manner. Detailed planning will take the location principles for wind power into account.
section_header: 4.2.2 Energy-efficient land use and city structure
extraction_rationale: Planning policy for renewable energy deployment.

parent_statement: Key actions related to detailed planning
policy_statement: Use detailed planning to enable construction projects to exceed national energy efficiency levels and support energy-efficient renovations through additional construction principles.
source_quote: 56. Detailed planning will be used to facilitate further planning to make the energy efficiency of construction projects exceed the national level, while also taking regional characteristics into account. Regional planning principles will be prepared as the basis for changes in city planning.
section_header: 4.2.2 Energy-efficient land use and city structure
extraction_rationale: Planning intervention to require or enable stronger energy efficiency than national baseline.

parent_statement: Key actions related to detailed planning
policy_statement: Use detailed planning to steer construction features that influence energy consumption habits, such as shared spaces and lighting conditions.
source_quote: 57. Detailed planning will be used to steer construction where it can be used to influence the energy consumption habits of people. Such matters include shared spaces, lighting conditions, etc.
section_header: 4.2.2 Energy-efficient land use and city structure
extraction_rationale: Planning-based demand reduction intervention for building energy use.

parent_statement: Key actions related to detailed planning
policy_statement: Develop land-use planning regulations to expand methods supporting carbon-neutrality, renewable energy production and energy efficiency while allowing trials and new technologies.
source_quote: 58. By developing the regulations on land use planning, the selection of methods that support carbon-neutrality can be expanded. The regulation collection for land use planning will include regulations which are related to the use and production of renewable energy and energy efficiency.
section_header: 4.2.2 Energy-efficient land use and city structure
extraction_rationale: Regulatory planning reform explicitly supporting carbon neutrality.

parent_statement: Key actions related to plot conveyance
policy_statement: Include energy efficiency requirements stricter than national requirements in City plot conveyance conditions and update them as national requirements advance.
source_quote: 59. The City's conditions for plot conveyance will include energy efficiency requirements that are stricter than the requirements at national level. The requirements for energy efficiency will promote energy conservation and the production of renewable energy for buildings.
section_header: 4.2.2 Energy-efficient land use and city structure
extraction_rationale: Binding land-disposal condition for energy efficiency and renewable energy.

parent_statement: Key actions related to plot conveyance
policy_statement: Collect experience on smart energy solutions required in plot conveyance and gradually adopt them in all plot conveyance conditions where possible.
source_quote: The City will collect experiences of the effects of the smart energy solutions required in plot conveyance, and the solutions will be gradually adopted for all plot conveyance conditions, when possible. Collecting the experiences and potentially developing the conditions requires expertise we do not currently possess.
section_header: 4.2.2 Energy-efficient land use and city structure
extraction_rationale: Although the number is obscured in the provided text, this is a concrete plot-conveyance policy for smart energy requirements.

parent_statement: Key actions related to plot conveyance
policy_statement: Include carbon footprint and eco-efficiency criteria in quality-based plot conveyance competitions.
source_quote: 61. In plot conveyance competitions based on quality, the criteria will include the carbon footprint and eco-efficiency of the construction project. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Land Property Development and Plots.
section_header: 4.2.2 Energy-efficient land use and city structure
extraction_rationale: Procurement/land competition criterion directly targeting construction carbon footprint.

parent_statement: Key actions related to plot conveyance
policy_statement: Implement plot conveyance competitions specifically aiming at carbon-neutrality and use lessons to develop conveyance conditions.
source_quote: 62. The City will implement plot conveyance competitions that aim particularly at carbon-neutrality, the experiences from which will be analysed. The experiences gathered will be used when developing the terms and conditions for plot conveyance.
section_header: 4.2.2 Energy-efficient land use and city structure
extraction_rationale: Concrete competitive land-allocation mechanism for carbon-neutral projects.

parent_statement: Key actions related to building control
policy_statement: Develop pre-emptive guidance for housing companies to promote energy-efficient renovations and renewable energy, including geothermal instructions and possible licence fee exemptions.
source_quote: 63. Pre-emptive guidance for housing companies (for example, in the project planning stage) will be developed to promote energy-efficient renovations and the use of renewable energy sources. Additionally, the opportunity to exempt geothermal heating projects from building control licence fees will be explored.
section_header: 4.2.2 Energy-efficient land use and city structure
extraction_rationale: Building-control guidance and potential fee incentive for efficiency and renewables.

parent_statement: Key actions related to building control
policy_statement: Prepare operating models and examples for energy-efficient renovation solutions in protected buildings.
source_quote: 64. Operation models and good examples for energy-efficient solutions in the renovation of protected buildings will be prepared. In the preliminary negotiations for permit projects, the parties will be instructed on the many means through which the energy efficiency of the buildings can be improved.
section_header: 4.2.2 Energy-efficient land use and city structure
extraction_rationale: Specific guidance intervention for hard-to-renovate protected buildings.

parent_statement: Key actions related to building control
policy_statement: Examine how climate objectives can be incorporated when updating the building code.
source_quote: 65. The City will examine how climate objectives can be taken into account when updating the building code. Parties responsible: Administrative and Support Services / legal department, Land Use and City Structure.
section_header: 4.2.2 Energy-efficient land use and city structure
extraction_rationale: Regulatory review commitment to embed climate objectives in building code.

parent_statement: Key actions related to building control
policy_statement: Prepare a roadmap or service path for developing building control at all construction stages to enable energy-efficient construction.
source_quote: 66. A road map or service path will be prepared for the development of building control in all stages of a construction project to enable energyefficient construction. The Buildings and Public Areas Division will work on the development in its own processes; for example: the environmental management model.
section_header: 4.2.2 Energy-efficient land use and city structure
extraction_rationale: Building-control process reform to enable energy-efficient construction.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the energy renaissance
policy_statement: Prepare and implement an energy renaissance programme supporting energy-efficient renovation of neighbourhoods and private existing building stock.
source_quote: 67. An energy renaissance programme will be prepared to support the renovation of neighbourhoods and the existing private building stock energyefficiently. Time span: Council terms of 2017-2021 (planning), 2022-2035 (implementation).
extraction_rationale: Named programme with planning and implementation phases to improve private building energy efficiency.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the energy renaissance
policy_statement: Investigate ending oil heating by 2035 and increasing renewable energy and energy efficiency in electrically heated buildings, including a pilot area.
source_quote: 68. The City will investigate ending oil heating by 2035 and increasing the use of renewable energy and the energy efficiency in electrically heated buildings. A pilot area will be selected.
extraction_rationale: Specific fossil heating phase-out investigation with deadline and pilot.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the energy renaissance
policy_statement: Develop the 3D Energy and Climate Atlas and energy tools for resident guidance on building energy costs and improvements.
source_quote: 69. The 3D model (the Energy and Climate Atlas) will be developed in the energy efficiency guidance for residents. Energy tools for the assessment of the costs and potential improvements in buildings' energy consumption will be developed.
extraction_rationale: Specific digital guidance tool for building energy efficiency.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the energy renaissance
policy_statement: Improve energy competence among housing cooperative decision-makers through training and case presentations on energy efficiency, renewables and maintenance.
source_quote: 70. The energy-related competences of the decision-makers in housing cooperatives will be improved. Decision-makers of housing cooperatives will receive training on the improvement of energyefficiency, the use of renewable energy and systematic maintenance.
extraction_rationale: Capacity-building policy to unlock private building energy renovations.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new energy solutions
policy_statement: Helen will implement consumer-end emissions reduction actions including district heating measurement, tariff reform studies and open energy-consumption monitoring interfaces.
source_quote: 71. Helen Ltd will implement emissions reduction actions based on its own development programme and decisions. The actions include: Continuing the inspection of the measurements of the properties' district heating connections and changing the tariffs for properties to match the more accurate measurements.
extraction_rationale: Specific energy-system operational and tariff measures to reduce emissions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new energy solutions
policy_statement: Identify and schedule City acquisition of renewable district heating and create a plan for reaching 100% renewable district heating.
source_quote: 72. The opportunities to acquire renewable district heating will be identified in the City organisation, as will the cost effects thereof. A plan will be created for the acquisition of renewable district heating and on the date when its proportion will reach 100 per cent of all district heating.
extraction_rationale: Renewable heat procurement planning with a 100% target.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new energy solutions
policy_statement: Acquire renewable or emission-free electricity through scheduled purchasing-unit plans.
source_quote: 73. The City will acquire renewable/emission-free electricity. Purchasing units will prepare a scheduled plan for the switch to renewable electricity.
extraction_rationale: Direct renewable electricity procurement commitment.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new energy solutions
policy_statement: Automate primary water consumption measurement to be hour-based and remotely readable, with HSY recommending consumption-based invoicing.
source_quote: 74. The primary measurement of water consumption will be automated and made hour-based and remotely readable. HSY recommends consumption-based invoicing.
extraction_rationale: Water metering and pricing information measure for resource efficiency; climate relevance is indirect.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new energy solutions
policy_statement: Create an energy-wellness data model to encourage all properties to improve energy efficiency and consumption, with a €200,000 cost estimate.
source_quote: 75. The City will encourage all properties in the City area to take action to improve energy efficiency and energy consumption. A data model will be created, which will allow interested parties to see the 'energy wellness' of their own property, compared to a reference group.
extraction_rationale: Specific data tool and resource allocation to promote building energy efficiency.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new energy solutions
policy_statement: Investigate, pilot and adopt two-way district heating in City properties.
source_quote: 76. Two-way district heating in the City properties will be investigated, piloted and adopted. Parties responsible: Buildings and Public Areas / Built Assets Management, Helen.
extraction_rationale: Specific energy-system pilot and adoption commitment.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new energy solutions
policy_statement: Study property-level and system-level impacts of hybrid heat pump and district heating systems and create implementation recommendations.
source_quote: 77. The technical, economical and emission-related impacts of a hybrid heating system, combining a heat pump and district heating, will be studied at the level of individual properties and the entire energy system. Based on the results of the study, recommendations will be created for the connections and implementation of the hybrid systems to ensure that the functions are energy-efficient and cost-efficient.
extraction_rationale: Specific technical study and recommendations for low-emission heating systems.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new energy solutions
policy_statement: Take land-use needs of centralised and regional renewable energy production into account.
source_quote: 78. The land-use needs of centralised and regional production of renewable energy will be taken into account. Parties responsible: Helen, Land Use and City Structure / Detailed Planning, Strategic Urban Planning.
extraction_rationale: Planning commitment to enable renewable energy infrastructure.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new energy solutions
policy_statement: Identify major waste heat sources, plan utilisation actions, and analyse impacts of sewage heat utilisation in properties.
source_quote: 79. The most significant potential heat waste locations will be identified, and actions to utilise this heat waste will be planned. The impact the utilisation of sewage heating in properties will have on the water treatment plant will be analysed.
extraction_rationale: Waste heat recovery planning for energy efficiency and emissions reductions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new energy solutions
policy_statement: Assess geothermal well space requirements in the Underground Master Plan and mediate regional and hybrid energy solution adoption.
source_quote: 80. The space allocation requirements of the geothermal wells will be assessed as a part of the preparation of the Underground Master Plan. The City will be an active mediator between constructors and Helen as regional energy options and hybrid solutions are examined, which will promote the adoption of such solutions.
extraction_rationale: Planning and facilitation action for geothermal and hybrid renewable energy systems.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new energy solutions
policy_statement: Survey areas suitable for geo-energy and geothermal heating potential.
source_quote: 81. The areas suitable for geo-energy will be surveyed (survey for geothermal heating potential). Parties responsible: Executive Office / neighbourhood construction, Land Use and City Structure / Geo, Strategic Urban Planning / Technical and Economic Planning.
extraction_rationale: Specific renewable heat resource assessment.

parent_statement: Key actions related to new energy solutions
policy_statement: Further examine recovery and utilisation of landfill gases from closed landfills in Helsinki.
source_quote: 82. Opportunities to recover and utilise the landfill gases of closed landfills in the Helsinki area will be examined further, with the help of surveys and reports made in the past.
extraction_rationale: Specific methane recovery assessment for emissions reduction and energy use.

parent_statement: Key actions related to funding and incentives
policy_statement: Inform financial institutions about opportunities to share information on energy renovation loans through the energy efficiency information page.
source_quote: 83. When meeting with financial institutions, the City will tell them about the opportunity to spread information, e.g. about energy renovation loans, via the information page on energy efficiency.
extraction_rationale: Information measure supporting uptake of private finance for energy renovations; not itself a financial instrument.

parent_statement: Key actions related to funding and incentives
policy_statement: Survey financial obstacles to energy efficiency projects, including ARA funding restrictions.
source_quote: 84. The City will survey the financial obstacles of energy efficiency projects (such as the restrictions of the ARA funding). Parties responsible: Executive Office / Financial and Planning Division, Buildings and Public Areas / Built Assets Management, Heka / ATT Housing Production.
extraction_rationale: Specific assessment of financing barriers for energy efficiency investments.

parent_statement: Key actions related to funding and incentives
policy_statement: Monitor new funding and procurement models, benchmark other cities, and adopt suitable procedures.
source_quote: 85. The means of adopting new funding and procurement models will be monitored, the procedures of other cities will be benchmarked, and suitable procedures will be taken into use.
extraction_rationale: Operational commitment to adopt financing/procurement models for climate-related building measures.

parent_statement: Key actions related to funding and incentives
policy_statement: Pilot ESCO energy-service projects within a selected Helsinki Group subsidiary community.
source_quote: 86. The usability of the ESCO project in the Helsinki Group will be piloted in a chosen subsidiary community. Parties responsible: Executive Office / Financial and Planning Division, Buildings and Public Areas / Built Assets Management, a subsidiary community.
extraction_rationale: Specific energy performance service financing/procurement model pilot.

parent_statement: Key actions related to funding and incentives
policy_statement: Negotiate with the State for support for housing cooperative energy renovations, renewable energy increases and oil vessel replacement, and identify City support measures.
source_quote: 87. The City will negotiate with the State to receive support for the energy renovations of housing cooperatives and for increasing the proportion of renewable energy, including the replacement of oil vessels. The potential support measures to be offered by the City will be identified.
extraction_rationale: Support and subsidy-oriented policy for building energy renovation and fossil heating replacement.

parent_statement: Key actions related to wooden construction
policy_statement: Promote wooden construction through detailed planning.
source_quote: 88. The City will promote wooden construction through detailed planning. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Detailed Planning.
section_header: 4.2.7 Reducing the carbon footprint of buildings
extraction_rationale: Planning policy to reduce lifecycle construction emissions and increase carbon storage in materials.

parent_statement: Key actions related to wooden construction
policy_statement: Promote wooden construction in City-owned projects.
source_quote: 89. The City will promote wooden construction in its own projects. Parties responsible: Buildings and Public Areas / Built Assets Management, ATT Housing Production, Heka Housing, HASO, Auroranlinna.
section_header: 4.2.7 Reducing the carbon footprint of buildings
extraction_rationale: Direct municipal construction commitment to use low-carbon timber construction.

parent_statement: Key actions related to education
policy_statement: Strengthen climate mitigation and circular economy skills in school curricula and schoolwork and expand teachers' knowledge.
source_quote: 90. The skills related to the mitigation of climate change and to circular economy will be strengthened in school curricula and in schoolwork, in general. Teachers' knowledge will be expanded.
extraction_rationale: Education policy supporting climate mitigation and circular economy capacity.

parent_statement: Key actions related to education
policy_statement: Offer educational institutions Smart & Clean internships, participate in joint development projects, and support campuses in adopting low-carbon solutions.
source_quote: 91. The City will offer educational institutions internships in Smart & Clean, participate in joint development projects and support the institutions and their campuses in the adoption of low-carbon solutions.
extraction_rationale: Capacity-building and implementation support for low-carbon solutions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to education
policy_statement: Increase environmental education in early childhood education and schools.
source_quote: 92. The amount of environmental education in early childhood education and schools will be increased. Parties responsible: Education, Environmental Services / Harakka.
extraction_rationale: Education commitment with indirect but recognized climate relevance.

parent_statement: Key actions related to education
policy_statement: Organise climate mitigation, adaptation, circular economy and sharing economy courses for employees, representatives and residents.
source_quote: 93. The City will organise courses and education on the mitigation of and adaptation to climate change, as well as circular economy and sharing economy for its employees, representatives and residents.
extraction_rationale: Specific training action covering climate mitigation and adaptation.

parent_statement: Key actions related to education
policy_statement: Promote urban agriculture by crowdsourcing suitable spaces and defining criteria and rules for their use.
source_quote: 94. Urban agriculture will be promoted by using crowdsourcing to survey spaces suitable to be used by the residents. The criteria for spaces suitable for urban agriculture and the rules for the use of these spaces will be defined.
extraction_rationale: Specific intervention for local food production; climate relevance is indirect through consumption footprint.

parent_statement: Key actions related to consumption and waste management
policy_statement: Develop recipes to reduce emissions from City food services and protect the Baltic Sea.
source_quote: 95. Recipes will be developed to reduce the emissions from the City's food services and protect the Baltic Sea. Parties responsible: Education, Social Services and Health Care, Service Centre, Palmia Oy.
extraction_rationale: Specific food-service intervention explicitly targeting emissions reduction.

parent_statement: Key actions related to consumption and waste management
policy_statement: Increase the proportion of vegetarian meals in schools and day care centres.
source_quote: 96. The proportion of vegetarian meals will be increased in schools and day care centres. The recommendations for both school meals and the meals in early childhood education encourage institutions to increase the proportion of vegetarian food.
extraction_rationale: Specific food consumption measure to reduce dietary emissions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to consumption and waste management
policy_statement: Reduce food waste in Service Centre, Palmia and interest group operations through monitoring, campaigns, efficiency and product rationalisation.
source_quote: 97. Food waste will be reduced in the operations of the Service Centre, Palmia and other interest groups. For example: by monitoring consumption and thus making appropriately-sized portions and ordering the right amount of food, by using campaigns, by making the processes more efficient and by rationalising the product selection and the package sizes.
extraction_rationale: Specific waste reduction intervention with operational measures.

parent_statement: Key actions related to consumption and waste management
policy_statement: Examine opportunities to transport food optimally in terms of emissions.
source_quote: 98. The opportunities to transport food optimally in terms of emissions will be examined. For example: climate-friendly and long-life packaging; making deliveries more efficient.
extraction_rationale: Specific logistics assessment for food-service emissions reduction.

parent_statement: Key actions related to consumption and waste management
policy_statement: Increase collaboration with grocery shops to reduce food waste by transferring excess food to community uses.
source_quote: 99. Collaboration with grocery shops will be increased to reduce food waste. For example: by transferring excess food from grocery shops to youth centres, home economics classes, courses in adult education institutes or the Shared Table initiative.
extraction_rationale: Specific partnership and redistribution mechanism for reducing food waste.

parent_statement: Key actions related to consumption and waste management
policy_statement: Update environmental criteria for events, encourage EcoCompass use, and develop tools for measuring event CO2 emissions.
source_quote: 100. The environmental criteria for events will be updated and materials to help with the planning of environmental matters will be produced. Tools for measuring the CO2 emissions of events will be developed.
extraction_rationale: Event management standards and CO2 measurement tools support emissions reductions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to consumption and waste management
policy_statement: Examine and use methods of personal emissions trading used in various cities.
source_quote: 101. The methods of personal emissions trading used in various cities will be examined and used. Parties responsible: Environmental Services.
extraction_rationale: Personal emissions trading is a carbon pricing/market instrument.

parent_statement: Key actions related to consumption and waste management
policy_statement: Incorporate sustainable tourism, carbon-neutrality and Baltic Sea protection into the maritime strategy.
source_quote: 102. The principles of sustainable tourism, carbon-neutrality and the protection of the Baltic Sea will be taken into account in the preparation of the maritime strategy.
extraction_rationale: Strategic planning commitment with explicit carbon-neutrality principle.

parent_statement: Key actions related to consumption and waste management
policy_statement: Enable efficient source separation of all separately collected waste in all City organisation facilities.
source_quote: 103. Efficient source separation of all separately collected waste will be made possible in all facilities of the City organisation. Parties responsible: Buildings and Public Areas / Maintenance, Buildings and Public Areas / Built Assets Management, all divisions and City enterprises.
extraction_rationale: Waste sorting infrastructure action supporting material recovery.

parent_statement: Key actions related to consumption and waste management
policy_statement: Develop waste volume measurement, new technologies and logistics optimisation with HSY, including IoT, level measurement and weighing waste collection vehicles.
source_quote: 104. The measuring of waste volume, the utilisation of new technology and further optimisation of logistics, such as IoT, surface level measuring and weighing waste collection vehicles, will be developed with HSY.
extraction_rationale: Specific waste and logistics efficiency intervention.

parent_statement: Key actions related to consumption and waste management
policy_statement: Examine separating waste expenses from rent for external tenants to motivate waste reduction and sorting, and pilot block-level solutions.
source_quote: 105. The possibility of separating waste expenses from the rent in locations rented out to external parties by the City will be examined and decided on. If the external parties pay for their own waste expenses, they will be motivated to reduce waste and sort waste more efficiently.
extraction_rationale: Waste fee allocation is a financial/behavioural incentive for waste reduction.

parent_statement: Key actions related to consumption and waste management
policy_statement: Encourage City employees and residents to buy reused products from Pakila work centre, Uusix workshops and the Helsinki Metropolitan Area Reuse Centre.
source_quote: 106. City employees and residents will be encouraged to purchase products from the Pakila work centre, the Uusix workshops and the shops of the Helsinki Metropolitan Area Reuse Centre Ltd.
extraction_rationale: Specific reuse promotion action supporting circular economy.

parent_statement: Key actions related to procurements
policy_statement: Develop and introduce procurement criteria for lifecycle, circular economy and climate, using them as minimum requirements or weighted comparison criteria.
source_quote: 107. Existing procurement criteria will be developed and new criteria introduced to the procurements of the City of Helsinki, with regard to life cycle, circular economy and the climate. The environmental criteria must be the minimum requirements or the significantly weighed comparison criteria when making procurements.
extraction_rationale: Procurement policy with climate and circular economy criteria.

parent_statement: Key actions related to procurements
policy_statement: Identify procurements significant for greenhouse gas emissions and circular economy and develop emission calculations, lifecycle models and climate impact assessment.
source_quote: 108. Procurements that are significant in terms of greenhouse gas emissions and circular economy will be identified, and emission calculations, life cycle models and climate impact assessment will be developed for these procurements. The impact of procurements will be assessed in terms of the environment.
extraction_rationale: Specific procurement assessment policy for emissions and circular economy impacts.

parent_statement: Key actions related to procurements
policy_statement: Increase collaboration with companies through trials and pilots and seek funding for innovative procurements to reduce emissions.
source_quote: 109. Collaboration with companies will be increased through various trials and cooperation pilots, and funding will be sought for the implementation of innovative procurements to reduce emissions.
extraction_rationale: Innovation procurement and funding-seeking action explicitly aimed at emissions reduction.

parent_statement: Key actions related to procurements
policy_statement: Create strategic goals and a roadmap for sustainable and innovative procurements and update the City's procurement strategy.
source_quote: 110. Strategic goals are to be created for sustainable and innovative procurements in the Helsinki Group. A road map for innovative and sustainable procurements will be created, and the City's procurement strategy will be updated.
extraction_rationale: Strategic procurement governance commitment for sustainable innovation.

parent_statement: Key actions related to procurements
policy_statement: Increase regional collaboration on sustainable procurements, including joint training, reports, market surveys and minimum climate criteria for tendering.
source_quote: 111. Collaboration with the municipalities, joint municipal authorities and other public entities in the region will be increased on sustainable procurements. For example: joint training events, reports, market surveys and the definition of minimum requirements for climate criteria used in tendering.
extraction_rationale: Intergovernmental procurement coordination with explicit climate criteria.

parent_statement: Key actions related to procurements
policy_statement: Develop procurement planning and reporting, including procurement calendars, lifecycle-cost guidance, combined procurements, shared use and environmental monitoring.
source_quote: 112. The planning and reporting of procurements will be developed, for example by adopting procurement calendars and uniform City-level reporting procedures. Instructions for considering the overall economy of procurements (such as life cycle costs), combining procurements and increasing shared use of procurements will be increased.
extraction_rationale: Procurement process reform supporting lifecycle and shared-use resource efficiency.

parent_statement: Key actions related to procurements
policy_statement: Develop and tighten food and food-service procurement criteria to reduce environmental and climate impacts and incorporate circular economy.
source_quote: 113. The criteria that reduce the environmental and climate-related impact and take circular economy into account will be developed and tightened in the City's procurements related to foodstuffs and food service.
extraction_rationale: Procurement criteria explicitly targeting climate impact and circular economy in food services.

parent_statement: Key actions related to sharing economy and circular economy
policy_statement: Ensure the City's property strategy accounts for sharing economy and circular economy, including use of underused facilities by users who maintain them.
source_quote: 120. The City will see to that its property strategy will take sharing economy and circular economy into account (for example, by allowing the use of rarely used and poor-condition facilities by users that commit to maintaining the facilities).
extraction_rationale: Specific property-strategy action to increase resource utilisation; actions 114-119 were obscured in the provided OCR and not extracted.

parent_statement: Key actions related to sharing economy and circular economy
policy_statement: Advance cooperation among the City, companies, residents and others on circular economy, sharing economy and environmental responsibility through projects and pilots.
source_quote: 121. Cooperation with various parties (the City, companies, residents, etc.) will be advanced in terms of circular economy, sharing economy and environmental responsibility, for example through projects and pilots.
extraction_rationale: Concrete project/pilot cooperation action for circular and sharing economy.

parent_statement: Key actions related to sharing economy and circular economy
policy_statement: Conduct engaging budgeting from the perspective of sharing economy and circular economy.
source_quote: 122. The City will ensure that engaging budgeting will be conducted from the perspective of sharing economy and circular economy. Parties responsible: Executive office.
extraction_rationale: Budgeting process commitment to support resource-efficient circular and sharing economy.

parent_statement: Key actions related to Smart & Clean growth
policy_statement: Devise a Smart & Clean growth action plan defining baseline, monitoring, methods, actions, timeline, resources, steering, indicators, strengths and focus areas.
source_quote: 123. An action plan for Smart & Clean growth will be devised, the first phase of which will define the following: The starting point (jobs in S&C, companies, investments) and monitoring. The method selection, actions, time span, resources and steering of the plan.
section_header: 4.4 Smart & Clean growth - new jobs and business for Helsinki
extraction_rationale: Named plan to scale low-carbon and circular economy solutions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to Smart & Clean growth
policy_statement: Use procurements, steering measures and other means to create markets for products and services that help residents, companies and communities reduce emissions.
source_quote: 124. With procurements and available steering measures and other means, the City will support the creation of a market for new products and services that residents, companies and communities can use to reduce their own emissions.
section_header: 4.4 Smart & Clean growth - new jobs and business for Helsinki
extraction_rationale: Market-creation policy explicitly aimed at emissions-reducing products and services.

parent_statement: Key actions related to Smart & Clean growth
policy_statement: Give residents opportunities to influence and participate in developing new Smart & Clean solutions in an economically sustainable manner.
source_quote: 125. The residents are given opportunities to influence and participate in the development of new Smart & Clean solutions in an economically sustainable manner.
section_header: 4.4 Smart & Clean growth - new jobs and business for Helsinki
extraction_rationale: Engagement mechanism to develop climate solutions; broad but anchored in Smart & Clean solutions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to Smart & Clean growth
policy_statement: Create City operating models and criteria enabling economic policy objectives to be achieved alongside emissions reduction actions.
source_quote: 126. The City organisation will create operation models and criteria that enable the City to achieve its economic policy objectives simultaneously with the emissions reduction actions.
section_header: 4.4 Smart & Clean growth - new jobs and business for Helsinki
extraction_rationale: Governance action to integrate emissions reductions with economic policy.

parent_statement: Key actions related to Smart & Clean growth
policy_statement: Provide companies domestic market references and opportunities to develop solutions in Helsinki while promoting Helsinki as an international pioneer.
source_quote: 127. Companies will receive domestic market references, which will help with export. Domestic and international companies will be given opportunities to develop new solutions and operation models in Helsinki.
section_header: 4.4 Smart & Clean growth - new jobs and business for Helsinki
extraction_rationale: Innovation and market platform action for climate and clean solutions; climate link is indirect but explicitly under Smart & Clean emissions strategy.

parent_statement: Key actions related to Smart & Clean growth
policy_statement: Systematically develop Smart & Clean joint development platforms and increase their effectiveness in climate and circular economy solutions.
source_quote: 128. The City will systematically develop its Smart & Clean joint development platforms and increase their effectiveness in the development of climate and circular economy solutions.
section_header: 4.4 Smart & Clean growth - new jobs and business for Helsinki
extraction_rationale: Specific platform development for climate and circular economy solutions.

parent_statement: Key actions related to Smart & Clean growth
policy_statement: Require Helsinki Group organisations, subsidiaries and joint municipal authorities to integrate emissions reduction policies into control systems and at least reach carbon-neutrality by 2035.
source_quote: 129. The organisations, subsidiary communities and joint municipal authorities of the Helsinki Group will be required to integrate the emissions reduction policies into their respective control systems. The minimum objective is to reach carbon-neutrality by 2035.
section_header: 4.4 Smart & Clean growth - new jobs and business for Helsinki
extraction_rationale: Binding governance requirement and carbon-neutrality target for Helsinki Group entities.

policy_statement: Helen will increase renewable fuels to 25% and reduce CO2 emissions by 40% by 2025.
source_quote: Objectives by 2025: increasing the proportion of renewable fuels to reach 25 per cent (12 per cent in 2017) CO2 emissions reduction of 40 per cent.
section_header: 5 Helen Ltd's development programme and actions in the coming years
extraction_rationale: Quantified energy production targets with a deadline.

policy_statement: Helen aims to stop using coal entirely in the 2030s at the latest.
source_quote: Helen is preparing policies to continue its development programme. Helen is likely to meet the objectives set for its heating production by 2030, and it is aiming to reduce its greenhouse gas emissions by 40 per cent by 2025. To meet the carbon-neutrality objective for 2035, the use of fossil fuels needs to be reduced in Helen's heating production. Helen Ltd's objective is to stop using coal entirely in the 2030s, at the latest.
section_header: 1.2 Helsinki's climate objectives and the role of the City
extraction_rationale: Specific fossil fuel phase-out objective for the City-owned energy company.

parent_statement: Key actions related to carbon sinks
policy_statement: Account for carbon storage impacts in urban forest, nature and green-zone design and complement planning with procedures to compensate construction-related carbon storage loss.
source_quote: 130. The impact on carbon storage will be taken into account when designing urban forests and nature and public green zones. Planning and green zone design will be complemented with procedures to compensate for the carbon storage lost during construction.
extraction_rationale: Nature-based carbon storage policy with compensation procedures.

parent_statement: Key actions related to carbon sinks
policy_statement: Implement the Helsinki city plan forest network by reforesting open spots and adding tree stands that do not shade solar potential.
source_quote: 131. The forest network in the Helsinki city plan (including conservation areas and forests in the green network) will be implemented by reforesting open spots and complementing the city structure with tree stands that do not cast shadow on the solar power potential.
extraction_rationale: Reforestation and green-network implementation to maintain carbon sinks.

parent_statement: Key actions related to carbon sinks
policy_statement: Keep City-owned forests and wooded areas vegetative, covered and diverse through sustainable forestry.
source_quote: 132. Forests and wooded areas owned by the City (including City-owned areas outside the City borders) will be kept vegetative, covered and diverse with various tree species and sustainable forestry.
extraction_rationale: Forest management policy to preserve carbon sinks and biodiversity.

parent_statement: Key actions related to carbon sinks
policy_statement: Increase fruit trees, decorative trees, useful plants and shrubs on plots through awareness raising and communication.
