source_quote: 133. The number of fruit trees, decorative trees, useful plants and shrubs that offer climatefriendly local food will be increased on plots through raising of awareness and other forms of communication.
extraction_rationale: Urban greening and local food action; climate relevance includes carbon sinks and consumption effects.

parent_statement: Key actions related to carbon sinks
policy_statement: Use Helsinki's green factor method in planning and implementing new plots to ensure sufficient green structures.
source_quote: 134. The planning and implementation of new plots will use Helsinki's green factor method to ensure sufficient green structures on each plot. Parties responsible: Land Use and City Structure / Detailed Planning, Services and Permits/ Building Regulation.
extraction_rationale: Planning method requiring green structures on plots; supports carbon sinks and stormwater management.

parent_statement: Key actions related to carbon sinks
policy_statement: Update estimates of Helsinki carbon storage and sinks each council term and examine Helsinki Group carbon sink potential while developing metropolitan calculation and reporting methods.
source_quote: 135. An estimate of Helsinki's carbon storage and carbon sinks will be updated each council term, and the full carbon sink potential of the Helsinki Group will be examined. The calculation methods for and reporting on the shared carbon storage and carbon sinks of the metropolitan area will be developed.
extraction_rationale: Monitoring and methodological commitment for carbon sinks.

parent_statement: Key actions related to compensation
policy_statement: Assess Helsinki's emission compensation methods, needs and costs, examine other cities' methods, participate in collaboration on calculation rules, and aim for compensations that benefit the city through clean energy and carbon sequestration.
source_quote: 136. Helsinki's potential emission compensation methods, compensation needs and costs will be assessed. Helsinki will aim to implement the compensations in a fashion that will benefit the City, for example by actively creating conditions for the production of clean energy, such as wind power, and by sequestering carbon in the City area.
extraction_rationale: Compensation policy for residual emissions; includes financial offset logic and local clean-energy/carbon-sequestration mechanisms.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the adaptation to climate change
policy_statement: Finish adaptation policies and bring them into decision-making simultaneously with the Carbon-neutral Helsinki 2035 Action Plan.
source_quote: 137. The adaptation policies will be finished and brought into the decision-making process simultaneously with the Carbon-neutral Helsinki 2035 Action Plan. Parties responsible: Executive Office, Services and Permits / Environmental Services.
section_header: 7 It is necessary to adapt to climate change
extraction_rationale: Planning and adoption commitment for climate adaptation policies.

parent_statement: Key actions in communication and interaction
policy_statement: Develop, implement, monitor and regularly update a communication and interaction plan for the Action Plan.
source_quote: 138. A communication and interaction plan for the Action Plan will be developed. The communication strategy will be implemented, and it will be monitored and updated regularly.
extraction_rationale: Implementation-support policy for climate actions; enabling rather than direct technical action.

parent_statement: Key actions in communication and interaction
policy_statement: Develop engagement and interaction for Action Plan implementation according to Helsinki's engagement model, maximising openness and transparency.
source_quote: 139. The implementation of the Action Plan will develop engagement and interaction according to Helsinki's model for engagement and interaction, aiming for as much openness and transparency as possible.
extraction_rationale: Governance/engagement commitment enabling climate plan implementation.

parent_statement: Key actions in communication and interaction
policy_statement: Identify local activities significant for carbon-neutrality and seek an appropriate City role to promote them.
source_quote: 140. The City organisation will aim to identify local activities that are significant in terms of carbon-neutrality, for example with the help of the stadiluotsi service, and to seek a suitable role to promote these activities.
extraction_rationale: Local climate action identification and facilitation commitment.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the coordination of climate work
policy_statement: Found a climate and environmental management group to inform City executives, coordinate environmental management and climate work, and monitor and support action implementation.
source_quote: 141. A group for climate-related and environmental management will be founded. The group will be responsible for informing the City's executive group on the implementation of the Carbon-neutral Helsinki 2035 Action Plan, coordinating environmental management and climate work, and monitoring and supporting the implementation of the actions.
extraction_rationale: Governance mechanism for climate plan delivery.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the coordination of climate work
policy_statement: Set sector-specific emissions reduction objectives in City operational and economic planning.
source_quote: 142. In its operational and economic planning, the City will set sector-specific objectives in terms of emissions reductions. Parties responsible: Executive Office.
extraction_rationale: Target-setting commitment integrated into budgeting and operational planning.

parent_statement: Key actions related to the coordination of climate work
policy_statement: Establish a group or forum for City, business and interest-group cooperation, monitoring and sparring related to the Action Plan, and develop new climate discussion methods.
source_quote: 143. A group or forum will be established to facilitate the cooperation between the City, businesses and other interest groups, as well as the monitoring and sparring related to the Action Plan. In addition to this, new ways to discuss climate matters will be developed.
extraction_rationale: Collaborative governance mechanism for climate action implementation.

parent_statement: Key actions
policy_statement: Adopt open policy practice and related tools for Action Plan monitoring and create an operating model ensuring current information is available for implementation and updates.
source_quote: 144. Open policy practice and the related tools and principles are adopted in monitoring of the Action Plan. An operation model for the monitoring of the Action Plan will be created to ensure that the best and current information is always available.
extraction_rationale: Monitoring governance commitment for climate plan implementation.

parent_statement: Key actions related to reporting and impact assessment
policy_statement: Adopt assessment tools to monitor progress, costs, benefits, emissions development, green jobs, air quality, health impacts and other impacts of actions.
source_quote: 145. New assessment tools will be adopted and used for the monitoring of the progress, costs, benefits and emission development of the actions, as well as the development of green jobs, air quality, health impacts and other impacts.
extraction_rationale: Monitoring and evaluation tool adoption for emissions and co-benefit tracking.

parent_statement: Key actions related to reporting and impact assessment
policy_statement: Develop an annual reporting model for Helsinki Group operations and finances related to emissions reduction, for example through environmental reporting.
source_quote: 146. An operation model will be developed for the annual reporting of the operations and finances of the Helsinki Group in terms of emissions reduction; for example, as a part of environmental reporting.
extraction_rationale: Annual reporting process for emissions reduction work.

policy_statement: Assess the Action Plan during each council term.
source_quote: 147. Assessment of the Action Plan during each council term. Parties responsible: Services and Permits / Environmental Services.
extraction_rationale: Periodic evaluation commitment for the climate action plan.

policy_statement: Reduce Hiroshima City's total greenhouse gas emissions by 5% by FY2020, 30% by FY2030, and 80% by FY2050 compared with FY2013.
source_quote: To establish the reduction target of greenhouse gas emissions, the city will set the long-term target based on the national government's target, keeping in mind the city Hiroshima aims to become. This will follow by the mid-term and short-term targets increasing the reduction effect estimated from concrete measures, etc. Long-term Target FY2050 Compared to FY2013 ▲ 80%; Mid-term Target FY2030 Compared to FY2013 ▲ 30%; Short-term Target FY2020 Compared to FY2013 ▲ 5% (Compared to FY2005 ▲ 7%).
section_header: 2. Reduction target for greenhouse gas emissions
extraction_rationale: This is a citywide quantified greenhouse gas reduction target with explicit deadlines and base year, making it a clear mitigation policy.

policy_statement: Set FY2030 sectoral greenhouse gas reduction targets, including CO2 reductions of 7% for industry, 40% for households, 40% for business, 28% for transport, and 6.7% for waste, plus reductions for methane, dinitrogen monoxide, and CFC-alternative gases.
source_quote: Apart from the total target amount, we set the targets by sector as follows: -Carbon Dioxide: Industry sector ▲ 7%, Consumer/household sector ▲ 40%, Consumer/business sector ▲ 40%, Transport sector ▲ 28%, Waste ▲ 6.7%. -Methane ▲ 12.3%. -Dinitrogen monoxide: ▲ 6.1%. -4 gases such as chlorofluorocarbon alternatives: ▲ 25.1%.
section_header: *1 Setting of targets by sectors in the mid-term target
extraction_rationale: This sets quantified sectoral and gas-specific reduction targets for FY2030, which are binding planning commitments under the action plan.

policy_statement: Reduce total citywide energy use by 5% as the short-term energy reduction target.
source_quote: *2 Setting of short-term energy reduction target. Total amount of energy use that is not affected by the carbon dioxide emission factor of electric utility. -Total amount of energy use: ▲ 5%.
section_header: *2 Setting of short-term energy reduction target
extraction_rationale: This is a quantified energy-use reduction target, directly supporting the mitigation plan through energy efficiency.

policy_statement: Promote household energy-saving actions and environmental learning through global warming prevention campaigns.
source_quote: Take measures to promote energy saving actions and environment-related learning/education by global warming prevention campaign, etc. Take measures to promote the introduction of low-carbon houses with high energy-saving effect using innovative technology such as Net Zero Energy House (hereinafter called 'ZEH') and Net Zero Energy Building (hereinafter called 'ZEB'), and energy saving devices based on the state's Top Runner Program.
