policy_statement: Adopt 2030, 2035, and 2045 countywide GHG emissions reduction targets for unincorporated Los Angeles County.
source_quote: The Draft 2045 CAP's 2030 GHG emission reduction target was selected based on guidance provided in the 2017 Scoping Plan and was developed to demonstrate consistency with the statewide 2030 target shown in Table 2-7. The Draft 2045 CAP's 2030 target is based on a reduction from 2015 baseline levels and is equal to 40 percent below 2015 emissions (3.3 million MTCO2e).
section_header: 2.5.3 Greenhouse Gas Emissions Reduction Targets and Goals
extraction_rationale: This is a quantifiable climate mitigation target with deadlines and emissions levels. The quote directly supports the 2030 target; the same section also establishes 2035 and 2045 targets.

policy_statement: Develop a sunset strategy for all oil and gas operations, reducing operations 40 percent below 2015 levels by 2030, 60 percent by 2035, and 80 percent by 2045.
source_quote: Measure ES1: Develop a Sunset Strategy for All Oil and Gas Operations. The performance objectives for Measure ES1 are to reduce oil and gas operations 40 percent below 2015 levels by 2030, 60 percent by 2035, and 80 percent by 2045.
extraction_rationale: This is a named CAP measure with quantified targets and implementing actions. It directly reduces fossil fuel production and associated GHG emissions.

parent_statement: Measure ES1: Develop a Sunset Strategy for All Oil and Gas Operations
policy_statement: Collaborate with jurisdictions and utilities to develop an ordinance-based sunset strategy for all oil and gas operations prioritizing disproportionately affected communities.
source_quote: Action ES1.1 - Collaborate with other local jurisdictions and utilities to develop a sunset strategy for all oil and gas operations that prioritizes disproportionately affected communities. Develop an ordinance.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific regulatory action because it commits to developing an ordinance for oil and gas phase-out. It is directly tied to mitigation.

parent_statement: Measure ES1: Develop a Sunset Strategy for All Oil and Gas Operations
policy_statement: Develop a policy requiring examination of active, idle, and abandoned oil wells for fugitive GHG emissions.
source_quote: Action ES1.2 - Develop a policy that requires the examination of all active, idle, and abandoned oil wells for fugitive emissions of GHGs. Coordinate with federal and state agencies conducting fugitive emissions data.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific policy intervention with a regulatory inspection requirement for fugitive GHG emissions.

parent_statement: Measure ES1: Develop a Sunset Strategy for All Oil and Gas Operations
policy_statement: Develop a carbon removal strategy considering direct air capture and carbon capture and sequestration.
source_quote: Action ES1.3 - Develop a carbon removal strategy that considers direct air capture and carbon and sequestration (CCS).
extraction_rationale: This is a named planning intervention for carbon removal technologies. It directly targets atmospheric GHG reduction.

policy_statement: Procure zero-carbon electricity by achieving 100 percent municipal participation and 96 percent community participation in 100 percent renewable or zero-carbon electricity service by 2030.
source_quote: Measure ES2: Procure Zero-Carbon Electricity. The performance objectives for Measure ES2 are to achieve 100 percent participation in the CPA's Green Power option, Southern California Edison's (SCE's) Green Rate option, or other available 100 percent zero-carbon electricity service by 2030 for municipal accounts, and for community accounts to achieve 96 percent participation in the CPA's Green Power option, SCE's Green Rate option, or other available 100 percent zero-carbon electricity service by 2030 (accounting for an approximately 4 percent opt-out rate).
extraction_rationale: This measure sets quantified participation targets and a deadline for zero-carbon electricity procurement.

parent_statement: Measure ES2: Procure Zero-Carbon Electricity
policy_statement: Transition all County facilities in unincorporated areas to a 100 percent renewable electricity service option.
source_quote: Action ES2.1 - Transition all County facilities within unincorporated areas to CPA's 100% Green Power option, SCE's 100% Green Rate option, or other available 100% renewable electricity service.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific procurement commitment for municipal electricity supply.

parent_statement: Measure ES2: Procure Zero-Carbon Electricity
policy_statement: Complete community enrollment in CPA 100 percent Green Power or SCE Green Rate electricity options.
source_quote: Action ES2.2 - Complete enrollment of the community in CPA's 100% Green Power or SCE's Green Rate option.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific community electricity enrollment action for zero-carbon power procurement.

policy_statement: Increase renewable energy production through rooftop solar PV targets for existing and new buildings, County facilities, and affordable housing.
source_quote: Measure ES3: Increase Renewable Energy Production. The performance objectives for Measure ES3 are to: (1) install rooftop solar PV on 20 percent of existing residential buildings (multifamily and single-family), 25 percent by 2035, and 35 percent by 2045; (2) install rooftop solar PV on 15 percent of existing commercial buildings by 2030, 22 percent by 2035, and 32 percent by 2045; (3) install rooftop solar PV on 80 percent of new multi-family residential buildings by 2030, 85 percent by 2035, and 95 percent by 2045; (4) install rooftop solar PV installations on 40 percent of new commercial buildings by 2030, 50 percent by 2035, and 70 percent by 2045; (5) install 20,000 kilowatts of solar PV at County facilities by 2030; and (6) install rooftop solar PV at all affordable housing developments.
extraction_rationale: This named measure includes quantified renewable energy deployment targets and deadlines.

parent_statement: Measure ES3: Increase Renewable Energy Production
policy_statement: Require rooftop solar PV for all new development.
source_quote: Action ES3.1 - Require rooftop solar PV for all new development.
extraction_rationale: This is a clear regulatory requirement for renewable energy installation in new development.

parent_statement: Measure ES3: Increase Renewable Energy Production
policy_statement: Install rooftop solar PV at existing buildings.
source_quote: Action ES3.2 - Install rooftop solar PV at existing buildings.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific renewable energy deployment action for existing buildings.

parent_statement: Measure ES3: Increase Renewable Energy Production
policy_statement: Identify and install solar PV systems at viable County facilities and properties.
source_quote: Action ES3.3 - Identify and install solar PV systems at existing viable County facilities and properties.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete municipal renewable energy installation commitment.

parent_statement: Measure ES3: Increase Renewable Energy Production
policy_statement: Explore installing community-shared solar facilities on County properties where feasible.
source_quote: Action ES3.4 - Explore the feasibility to install community-shared solar facilities on County properties where opportunities exist.
extraction_rationale: This is a feasibility-oriented action rather than a guaranteed installation, but it is tied to a specific renewable energy intervention.

parent_statement: Measure ES3: Increase Renewable Energy Production
policy_statement: Require and incentivize renewable energy for new and existing affordable housing developments.
source_quote: Action ES3.5 - Require and incentivize renewable energy for affordable housing developments for both new development and existing buildings.
extraction_rationale: This combines a regulatory requirement with incentives for renewable energy deployment in affordable housing.

parent_statement: Measure ES3: Increase Renewable Energy Production
policy_statement: Streamline and prioritize permitting for solar and battery storage projects.
source_quote: Action ES3.6 - Streamline and prioritize permitting for solar and battery storage projects.
extraction_rationale: This is a permitting reform to accelerate renewable energy and storage deployment.

policy_statement: Increase energy resilience through community energy storage and generation, resilience hubs, solar and battery systems, microgrids, and energy assurance programs.
source_quote: Measure ES4: Increase Energy Resilience. The performance objectives for Measure E4 are to: (1) achieve community electricity storage and generation capacity equal to the community-wide 24-hour average usage by 2035/2045; (2) establish a community resilience hub program to equip community-serving County facilities (e.g., libraries, recreation centers, senior centers); (3) provide solar and battery systems sufficient to support emergency cooling and other emergency functions; (4) locate at least one hub in each County district, with a focus on vulnerable populations; (5) install microgrids based on a feasibility study; and (6) obtain a grant and establish a program to support an energy efficiency and assurance program for facilities that are large energy users and support critical community functions.
extraction_rationale: This measure has clear resilience outcomes and technology/program interventions. It is primarily adaptation because it strengthens energy reliability and emergency functions.

parent_statement: Measure ES4: Increase Energy Resilience
policy_statement: Develop a program to deploy community resilience hubs at scale.
source_quote: Action ES4.1 - Develop a program to deploy community resilience hubs at scale.
extraction_rationale: This is a named programmatic resilience intervention.

parent_statement: Measure ES4: Increase Energy Resilience
policy_statement: Invest in energy storage and microgrids at critical County facilities through CPA’s Power Ready Program.
source_quote: Action ES4.2 - Invest in energy storage and microgrids at critical County facilities through CPA's Power Ready Program.
extraction_rationale: This is a public investment in resilience infrastructure at critical facilities.

parent_statement: Measure ES4: Increase Energy Resilience
policy_statement: Develop a public community energy map identifying distributed energy and microgrid opportunities to improve energy resiliency.
source_quote: Action ES4.3 - Develop a publicly accessible community energy map that identifies opportunities for deploying distributed energy resources and microgrids to improve energy resiliency.
extraction_rationale: This is a planning and mapping action to support deployment of resilience infrastructure.

parent_statement: Measure ES4: Increase Energy Resilience
policy_statement: Conduct feasibility studies and adopt regulations for solar, storage, microgrids, and alternative technologies supporting demand management and grid resilience.
source_quote: Action ES4.4 - Conduct feasibility studies to identify priority areas for solar and storage, combined with building- and community-scale microgrids and alternative technologies such as fuel cells and grid paralleling, to support demand management and peak shaving to increase grid resilience. Study implementation, costs, barriers, and obstacles and identify partnerships. Adopt regulations that establish this use and standards for its development. Limiting peak energy demand can eliminate or reduce the use of high-carbon peaker plants.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific planning and regulatory action with resilience and emissions-reduction mechanisms.

parent_statement: Measure ES4: Increase Energy Resilience
policy_statement: Develop a Countywide program promoting energy efficiency and resilience measures in critical community service facilities.
source_quote: Action ES4.5 - Develop a Countywide program to promote energy efficiency and resilience measures in facilities providing critical community services.
extraction_rationale: This is a named countywide program combining efficiency and resilience for critical services.

policy_statement: Establish GHG requirements for new development to ensure consistency with the CAP’s goals and reduction targets.
source_quote: Measure ES5: Establish GHG Requirements for New Development. The performance objective for Measure ES5 is to require that new development is consistent with the Draft 2045 CAP's goals and GHG emissions reduction targets and to develop reach codes, ordinances, and conditions of approval as needed to achieve this objective. All new development not requiring General Plan amendments shall be consistent with the Draft 2045 CAP.
extraction_rationale: This is a regulatory consistency requirement for new development with explicit GHG targets.

parent_statement: Measure ES5: Establish GHG Requirements for New Development
policy_statement: Identify reach codes, ordinances, and conditions of approval for new development to reduce GHG emissions from energy, transportation, waste, water, and other sources.
source_quote: Action ES5.1 Identify new requirements for new development, including reach codes, ordinances, and conditions of approval to reduce GHG emissions from energy use, transportation, waste, water, and other sources. Include affordable housing considerations in these requirements, and develop supporting measures (financial support, technical assistance, or other incentives) to defray potential additional first costs in order to maintain housing affordability.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete regulatory development action for GHG reduction, with additional affordability support measures.

parent_statement: Measure ES5: Establish GHG Requirements for New Development
policy_statement: Implement the 2045 CAP consistency checklist for new development.
source_quote: Action ES5.2 Implement the 2045 CAP consistency review checklist for new development to demonstrate consistency with the 2045 CAP's strategies, measures, and actions.
extraction_rationale: This creates an implementation mechanism for applying CAP requirements to new development.

parent_statement: Measure ES5: Establish GHG Requirements for New Development
policy_statement: Evaluate a program to reduce GHG emissions for new development requiring General Plan amendments.
source_quote: Action ES5.3 Evaluate a program for reducing GHG emissions for new development that require General Plan amendments.
extraction_rationale: This is a program evaluation commitment targeting GHG emissions from a defined development category.

parent_statement: Measure ES5: Establish GHG Requirements for New Development
policy_statement: Establish an Offsite GHG Reduction Program for new development compliance and to fund built-environment GHG reduction programs.
source_quote: Action ES5.4 Establish an Offsite GHG Reduction Program for new development to use as a GHG reduction or mitigation pathway for 2045 CAP compliance and to fund programs for reducing GHG emissions in the built environment.
extraction_rationale: This is a financial and compliance mechanism to fund or implement offsite GHG reductions.

policy_statement: Increase density near high-quality transit areas to reduce VMT and expand housing near transit.
source_quote: Measure T1: Increase Density near High-Quality Transit Areas. The performance objectives for Measure T1 are to: (1) achieve a minimum of 20 dwelling units (DUs) per acre (maximum of 30-150 DUs per acre) for HQTAs; (2) locate a majority of residential and employment centers in the unincorporated Los Angeles County within 1 mile of an HQTA; and (3) achieve a 27 percent increase in dwelling units within HQTAs.
section_header: 2.6.2.2 Strategy 2: Increase Densities and Diversity of Land Uses near Transit
extraction_rationale: This measure has quantified density and location targets that reduce transportation emissions through land use change.

parent_statement: Measure T1: Increase Density near High-Quality Transit Areas
policy_statement: Incentivize residential and community-serving uses in HQTAs with parks and active transportation infrastructure.
source_quote: Action T.1.1 Incentivize residential and community-serving uses to be developed in high quality transit areas (HQTAs), while ensuring inclusion of vital public amenities, such as parks and active transportation infrastructure.
extraction_rationale: This is a land use incentive action that supports transit-oriented development and reduced VMT.

parent_statement: Measure T1: Increase Density near High-Quality Transit Areas
policy_statement: Develop land use tools to increase diverse housing types, including missing middle housing.
source_quote: Action T.1.2 Develop land use tools that will increase the production of a diversity of housing types, such as missing middle housing.
extraction_rationale: This is a land-use planning tool commitment supporting compact and diverse housing patterns; climate link is via transit-oriented VMT reduction context.

policy_statement: Develop land use plans addressing jobs-housing balance and mixed use to reduce trips and VMT.
source_quote: Measure T2: Develop Land Use Plans Addressing Jobs-Housing Balance and Increase Mixed Use. The performance objective for Measure T2 is to achieve a job density of 300 jobs per acre for all new projects with nonresidential development by 2030. For communities with an imbalance of jobs/housing (±20 percent), community plans will identify and quantify strategies for bringing that imbalance below 20 percent.
section_header: 2.6.2.2 Strategy 2: Increase Densities and Diversity of Land Uses near Transit
extraction_rationale: This measure has quantified land use planning objectives and aims to reduce VMT.

parent_statement: Measure T2: Develop Land Use Plans Addressing Jobs-Housing Balance and Increase Mixed Use
policy_statement: Develop community plans to increase residents’ ability to live and work in the same community and decrease VMT.
source_quote: Action T.2.1 Develop community plans that will increase the percentage of residents who could live and work within the same community, and that could decrease VMT.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific community planning action with an explicit VMT reduction goal.

policy_statement: Expand bicycle and pedestrian networks to serve residential, employment, and recreational trips, including a 300 percent increase in bikeway miles by 2035.
source_quote: Measure T3: Expand Bicycle and Pedestrian Network to Serve Residential, Employment, and Recreational Trips. The performance objective for Measure T3 is to increase bikeway miles by 300 percent by 2035. This measure also requires implementing the County Bicycle Master Plan and completing updates to County's Pedestrian Action Plan, Bicycle Master Plan, and Active Transportation Plans every five years.
extraction_rationale: This measure has a quantified active transportation infrastructure target and plan implementation requirements.

parent_statement: Measure T3: Expand Bicycle and Pedestrian Network to Serve Residential, Employment, and Recreational Trips
policy_statement: Create a more connected and safer bikeway network by expanding bikeway facilities and implementing protected and separated lanes.
source_quote: Action T3.1 Create a more connected and safer bikeway network by expanding bikeway facilities and implementing protected and separated lanes.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific active transportation infrastructure action to reduce single-occupancy vehicle trips.

parent_statement: Measure T3: Expand Bicycle and Pedestrian Network to Serve Residential, Employment, and Recreational Trips
policy_statement: Implement and regularly update the County’s Pedestrian Action Plan, Bicycle Master Plan, and Active Transportation Plans.
source_quote: Action T3.2 Implement and regularly update the County's Pedestrian Action Plan, Bicycle Master Plan, and Active Transportation Plans.
extraction_rationale: This is a continuing plan implementation and update commitment for active transportation.

parent_statement: Measure T3: Expand Bicycle and Pedestrian Network to Serve Residential, Employment, and Recreational Trips
policy_statement: Develop and implement a Shaded Corridors Program with energy-efficient lighting and shade at major transit stops, prioritizing high heat vulnerability communities.
source_quote: Action T3.3 Collaborate with Metro and other transit providers to enhance pedestrian and bicycle environments through energy efficient lighting and shading to promote active transportation. Build shade structures at major transit stops, such as those identified in Metro's Active Transportation Strategic Plan, prioritizing communities with high heat vulnerability. Develop and implement a Shaded Corridors Program.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific program and infrastructure intervention. It reduces vehicle trips through active transportation while explicitly addressing high heat vulnerability.

policy_statement: Broaden transit, active transportation, and alternative mode options by doubling transit service hours, installing bus priority infrastructure, and ensuring 75 percent of residents live near bus or active transportation options by 2030.
source_quote: Measure T4: Broaden Options for Transit, Active Transportation, and Alternative Modes of Transportation. The performance objectives for Measure T4 are by 2030 to: (1) double transit service hours from 560,000 to 1.12 million; (2) install bus-only lanes and signal prioritization on all major transit thoroughfares; and (3) have a minimum of 75 percent of unincorporated Los Angeles County residents live within one-half mile of a bus or active transportation option.
extraction_rationale: This is a quantified transportation mode-shift policy package that reduces VMT and emissions.

parent_statement: Measure T4: Broaden Options for Transit, Active Transportation, and Alternative Modes of Transportation
policy_statement: Expand and improve unincorporated County shuttle frequency and explore new mobility services.
source_quote: Action T4.1 Expand and improve the frequency of service of unincorporated Los Angeles County shuttles and explore new mobility services, such as micro transit, autonomous delivery vehicles, micro mobility, and on-demand autonomous shuttles.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific transit and mobility service expansion action to reduce VMT.

parent_statement: Measure T4: Broaden Options for Transit, Active Transportation, and Alternative Modes of Transportation
policy_statement: Install bus-only lanes, signal prioritization, and bus rapid transit infrastructure along priority corridors where appropriate.
source_quote: Action T4.2 Collaborate with Metro and other transit providers to install bus-only lanes and/or signal prioritization along major thoroughfares, and work with transit agencies and neighboring jurisdictions to plan and install full bus rapid transit infrastructure along priority corridors, as appropriate.
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete transit priority infrastructure action.

parent_statement: Measure T4: Broaden Options for Transit, Active Transportation, and Alternative Modes of Transportation
policy_statement: Develop a transportation technology strategy to support public transit.
source_quote: Action T4.3 Collaborate with Metro and other transit providers to develop a transportation technology strategy to proactively address how evolving tech- enabled mobility options can support public transit.
extraction_rationale: This is a named strategy development commitment for transit-supportive technology.

parent_statement: Measure T4: Broaden Options for Transit, Active Transportation, and Alternative Modes of Transportation
policy_statement: Set aside maintenance funds to keep public transit facilities safe and clean to enhance transit experience and ridership.
source_quote: Action T4.4 Collaborate with Metro and other transit providers to set aside maintenance funds to ensure that public transit facilities, including stations and stops, are safe and clean to enhance the transit experience and increase ridership.
extraction_rationale: This is a funding allocation for transit facility maintenance intended to increase ridership and reduce vehicle trips.

parent_statement: Measure T4: Broaden Options for Transit, Active Transportation, and Alternative Modes of Transportation
policy_statement: Develop and implement a transportation demand management ordinance requiring future development projects to include measures such as subsidized transit passes and car share.
source_quote: Action T4.5 Collaborate with Metro and other transit providers to develop and implement a transportation demand management (TDM) ordinance that requires future development projects to incorporate measures such as subsidized transit passes and car share.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding regulatory mechanism for development projects to reduce vehicle trips.

parent_statement: Measure T4: Broaden Options for Transit, Active Transportation, and Alternative Modes of Transportation
policy_statement: Offer free or discounted transit passes for students, youth, seniors, people with disabilities, and low-income populations.
source_quote: Action T4.6 Offer free and/or discounted transit passes for students, youth, seniors, people with disabilities, and low-income populations.
extraction_rationale: This is a subsidy-like financial instrument to increase transit use and reduce vehicle trips.

parent_statement: Measure T4: Broaden Options for Transit, Active Transportation, and Alternative Modes of Transportation
policy_statement: Expand and improve the County’s telecommuting policy using alternative work program data.
source_quote: Action T4.7 Expand and improve the County's Telecommuting Policy, using data gathered through the alternative work program.
extraction_rationale: This is an operational policy to reduce commute trips and associated emissions.

parent_statement: Measure T4: Broaden Options for Transit, Active Transportation, and Alternative Modes of Transportation
policy_statement: Establish temporary and permanent car-free areas.
source_quote: Action T4.8 Establish temporary and permanent car-free areas.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific transportation demand and land-use intervention to reduce car use.

parent_statement: Measure T4: Broaden Options for Transit, Active Transportation, and Alternative Modes of Transportation
policy_statement: Develop a VMT bank or exchange program.
source_quote: Action T4.9 Develop a VMT bank or exchange program.
extraction_rationale: This is a programmatic mechanism to manage and reduce vehicle miles traveled.

parent_statement: Measure T4: Broaden Options for Transit, Active Transportation, and Alternative Modes of Transportation
policy_statement: Ensure all new forms of public transportation are low- or zero-emission.
source_quote: Action T4.10 Collaborate with Metro and other transit providers to ensure that all new forms of public transportation (e.g., new bus lines, new light rail service) are low- or zero-emission.
extraction_rationale: This is a direct low- or zero-emission transit procurement/service requirement.

policy_statement: Limit and remove parking minimums to reduce parking supply, unbundle parking costs, and implement parking pricing to encourage transit use and park-once behavior.
source_quote: Measure T5: Limit and Remove Parking Minimums. The performance objectives for Measure T5 are to: (1) reduce parking stipulations to reduce parking supply and encourage transit use; (2) unbundle parking costs to reflect the cost of parking; and (3) implement parking pricing to encourage 'park-once' behavior.
extraction_rationale: This is a transportation demand management measure with specific parking policy mechanisms to reduce car use.

parent_statement: Measure T5: Limit and Remove Parking Minimums
policy_statement: Implement comprehensive parking reform including eliminating residential minimums, establishing transit-area parking maximums, parking benefit districts, reuse strategies, and incentives for less parking.
source_quote: Action T5.1 Implement a comprehensive parking reform strategy, which should include, but not be limited to: elimination of minimum parking requirements for all new residential units, establishment of parking maximums within one-half mile of high-quality transit stops, creation and expansion of parking benefit districts, development of planning strategies for transitioning land dedicated to parking to alternative transit and public uses, and incentives for developers to provide less than maximum allowable parking.
extraction_rationale: This is a detailed regulatory and planning reform package for parking demand management.

policy_statement: Increase ZEV market share, reduce gasoline and diesel fuel sales, and install public/private and County EV charging stations through 2045.
source_quote: Measure T6: Increase ZEV Market Share and Reduce Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Sales. The performance objectives for Measure T6 are to: (1) increase the fleetwide percentage of light-duty vehicles in the unincorporated Los Angeles County that are ZEVs to 30 percent by 2030, 50 percent by 2035, and 90 percent by 2045; (2) increase the sales of new light-duty vehicles in the unincorporated Los Angeles County that are ZEVs to 68 percent by 2030 and 100 percent by 2035; (3) install 37,000 total new public and private shared EVCSs (including EVCSs at County facilities and properties) by 2030, 74,000 by 2035, and 140,000 by 2045; and (4) install 5,000 total new EVCSs at County facilities and properties by 2030, 10,000 by 2035, and 25,000 by 2045.
extraction_rationale: This measure has quantified vehicle electrification and charging targets with deadlines.

parent_statement: Measure T6: Increase ZEV Market Share and Reduce Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Sales
policy_statement: Develop a Zero Emission Vehicle Master Plan and collaborate with regional agencies and jurisdictions to share infrastructure.
source_quote: Action T6.1 Develop a Zero Emission Vehicle Master Plan. Collaborate with other regional agencies and jurisdictions to share infrastructure.
extraction_rationale: This is a named master plan and interagency infrastructure planning action for ZEV deployment.

parent_statement: Measure T6: Increase ZEV Market Share and Reduce Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Sales
policy_statement: Install EV charging stations at existing buildings and right-of-way infrastructure throughout unincorporated Los Angeles County.
source_quote: Action T6.2 Install EVCSs at existing buildings and right-of-way infrastructure throughout unincorporated Los Angeles County.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific infrastructure deployment action for EV adoption.

parent_statement: Measure T6: Increase ZEV Market Share and Reduce Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Sales
policy_statement: Require all new development to install EV charging stations through conditions of approval or ordinance.
source_quote: Action T6.3 Require all new development to install EVCSs through a condition of approval/ordinance. Residential development must install EVCSs; nonresidential development must install EVCSs at a percentage of total parking spaces.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding development requirement for EV charging infrastructure.

parent_statement: Measure T6: Increase ZEV Market Share and Reduce Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Sales
policy_statement: Install EV charging stations at County facilities and properties for public, employee, and fleet use, prioritizing BIPOC and disadvantaged communities.
source_quote: Action T6.4 Install EVCSs at County facilities and properties for public, employee, and fleet use, prioritizing locations in BIPOC and disadvantaged communities. Complete an assessment of EV charging locations, identifying gaps in publicly accessible stations for BIPOC and disadvantaged communities. Provide EV purchase incentive information in multiple languages to frontline communities.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific EV infrastructure installation and equity targeting action.

parent_statement: Measure T6: Increase ZEV Market Share and Reduce Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Sales
policy_statement: Pilot workplace vehicle-grid integration applications to reduce peak loads and store energy during renewable overproduction.
source_quote: Action T6.5 Continue to pilot vehicle-grid integration applications at workplaces to maximize the benefits that daytime charging for plug-in electric vehicles (PEVs) can have on the grid, including demand response to reduce peak loads and energy storage during periods of renewable overproduction.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific pilot program linking EV charging, grid management, and renewable energy storage.

parent_statement: Measure T6: Increase ZEV Market Share and Reduce Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Sales
policy_statement: Expand electric active transportation options and neighborhood electric vehicles through policies or ordinances.
source_quote: Action T6.6 Expand electric options for active transportation, such as electric scooters and e-bikes. Provide access to neighborhood electric vehicles, such as golf carts, shared EVs, and others. Develop policies and/or ordinances to expand these options.
extraction_rationale: This is a policy/ordinance action for low-emission mobility options.

parent_statement: Measure T6: Increase ZEV Market Share and Reduce Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Sales
policy_statement: Increase green hydrogen vehicle use and use biomethane and biogas from organic waste as bridge fuels toward 100 percent green hydrogen and electric vehicles.
source_quote: Action T6.7 Increase the use of green hydrogen vehicles. Use biomethane and biogas created from organic waste as a "bridge fuel" to achieve 100% green hydrogen and electric vehicles. Consider the use of other zero-emission fuel sources.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific low-carbon fuel and zero-emission vehicle transition action.

policy_statement: Electrify County bus, shuttle, and light-duty fleet vehicles by 2045.
source_quote: Measure T7: Electrify County Fleet Vehicles. The performance objectives for Measure T7 are to: (1) electrify the County bus and shuttle fleets by 2035; (2) increase the fleetwide percentage of light-duty vehicles in the County-owned fleet that are ZEVs to 35 percent by 2030, 60 percent by 2035, and 100 percent by 2045; and (3) support the state's goal that all new light-duty vehicle fleet purchases, with certain exceptions, will be ZEVs.
extraction_rationale: This measure sets quantified municipal fleet electrification targets.

parent_statement: Measure T7: Electrify County Fleet Vehicles
policy_statement: Electrify County bus, inmate transfer, and shuttle fleets and partner on shared charging or fueling infrastructure.
source_quote: Action T7.1 Electrify the County bus fleet, inmate transfer fleet, and shuttles, and partner with transit agencies for group purchasing and siting of shared charging and/or fueling infrastructure.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific municipal fleet electrification and infrastructure procurement action.

parent_statement: Measure T7: Electrify County Fleet Vehicles
policy_statement: Electrify light-duty County fleet vehicles.
source_quote: Action T7.2 Electrify light-duty County fleet vehicles.
extraction_rationale: This is a direct municipal fleet electrification commitment.

policy_statement: Accelerate freight decarbonization by increasing medium- and heavy-duty ZEV fleets, drayage ZEVs, ZEV truck sales, and warehouse loading dock charging infrastructure.
source_quote: Measure T8: Accelerate Freight Decarbonization. The performance objectives for Measure T8 are to: (1) increase the fleetwide percentage of medium-duty and heavy-duty vehicles in the unincorporated Los Angeles County that are ZEVs to 40 percent by 2030, 60 percent by 2035, and 90 percent by 2045; (2) increase the fleetwide percentage of medium-duty and heavy-duty trucks in the County-owned fleet that are ZEVs to 50 percent by 2030, 70 percent by 2035, and 95 percent by 2045; (3) ensure that 100 percent of the drayage truck fleet is ZEV by 2035; (4) ensure that 100 percent of sales of medium- and heavy-duty trucks are ZEVs by 2045; (5) require that all new warehouse loading docks have EVCSs by 2030; and (6) require that all existing warehouse loading docks have EVCSs by 2030.
extraction_rationale: This measure contains quantified zero-emission freight targets and charging requirements.

parent_statement: Measure T8: Accelerate Freight Decarbonization
policy_statement: Implement freight decarbonization technologies along highway corridors through programs such as zero-emission delivery zones.
source_quote: Action T8.1 Implement freight decarbonization technologies along highway corridors passing through unincorporated Los Angeles County communities through programs such as zero-emission delivery zones.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific freight decarbonization program action.

parent_statement: Measure T8: Accelerate Freight Decarbonization
policy_statement: Create an ordinance requiring new goods movement facilities to install alternative fueling infrastructure.
source_quote: Action T8.2 Create an ordinance requiring new goods movement facilities to install alternative fueling infrastructure.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding ordinance commitment for freight fueling infrastructure.

parent_statement: Measure T8: Accelerate Freight Decarbonization
policy_statement: Adopt building performance standards and reach codes requiring alternative fueling infrastructure for medium- and heavy-duty vehicles at goods movement facilities.
source_quote: Action T8.3 Adopt Building Performance Standards for existing goods movement facilities and reach code requirements for major retrofits and renovations that require alternative fueling infrastructure for medium- and heavy-duty vehicles. Require goods movement facilities to install alternative fueling infrastructure for medium- and heavy-duty vehicles at the point of sale.
extraction_rationale: This establishes building standards and point-of-sale requirements for freight decarbonization infrastructure.

parent_statement: Measure T8: Accelerate Freight Decarbonization
policy_statement: Streamline permitting for ZEV charging and fueling infrastructure for medium- and heavy-duty vehicles.
source_quote: Action T8.4 Streamline permitting of ZEV charging and fueling infrastructure for medium- and heavy-duty vehicles.
extraction_rationale: This is a permitting process reform to accelerate freight ZEV infrastructure.

parent_statement: Measure T8: Accelerate Freight Decarbonization
policy_statement: Electrify the County medium- and heavy-duty vehicle fleet.
source_quote: Action T8.5 Electrify the County medium- and heavy-duty vehicle fleet.
extraction_rationale: This is a direct municipal medium- and heavy-duty fleet electrification commitment.

policy_statement: Expand zero-emission technologies for off-road vehicles and equipment, reaching 95 percent ZEV off-road fleet/equipment and 100 percent ZEV construction, agriculture, and manufacturing equipment by 2045.
source_quote: Measure T9: Expand Use of Zero-Emission Technologies for Off-Road Vehicles and Equipment. The performance objectives for Measure T9 are to: (1) increase the fleetwide percentage of off-road fleet and equipment in the unincorporated Los Angeles County that are ZEVs to 20 percent by 2030, 50 percent by 2035, and 95 percent by 2045; and (2) increase the fleetwide percentage of construction, agriculture, and manufacturing equipment in the unincorporated Los Angeles County that are ZEVs to 50 percent by 2030, 75 percent by 2035, and 100 percent by 2045.
extraction_rationale: This measure has quantified zero-emission equipment transition targets.

parent_statement: Measure T9: Expand Use of Zero-Emission Technologies for Off-Road Vehicles and Equipment
policy_statement: Partner with South Coast and Antelope Valley air districts to increase zero- and near-zero-emission construction, agriculture, and manufacturing equipment.
source_quote: Action T9.1 Partner with the South Coast Air Quality Management District and Antelope Valley Air Quality Management District to increase the use of zero-emission and near-zero-emission construction, agriculture, and manufacturing equipment.
extraction_rationale: This is an interagency implementation action for low-emission equipment adoption.

parent_statement: Measure T9: Expand Use of Zero-Emission Technologies for Off-Road Vehicles and Equipment
policy_statement: Identify commercially available ZEV and green hydrogen equipment and require their use on all new projects through ordinance or conditions of approval.
source_quote: Action T9.2 Identify types of ZEV equipment and green hydrogen equipment that are commercially available (e.g., forklifts, loaders, welders, saws, pumps, fixed cranes, air compressors, sweepers, aerial lifts, pressure washers) and require the use of these types of equipment on all new projects through an ordinance or conditions of approval.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding ordinance/condition-of-approval action for zero-emission equipment.

parent_statement: Measure T9: Expand Use of Zero-Emission Technologies for Off-Road Vehicles and Equipment
policy_statement: Require zero- and near-zero-emission construction, agriculture, and manufacturing equipment for County projects to the maximum extent feasible.
source_quote: Action T9.3 Require, to the maximum extent feasible, the use of zero-emission and near-zero-emission construction, agriculture, and manufacturing equipment for County projects.
extraction_rationale: This is a municipal procurement/operational requirement for low-emission equipment.

policy_statement: Transition existing residential and nonresidential buildings to all-electric and require zero net energy for major renovations by 2045.
source_quote: Measure E1: Transition Existing Buildings to All-Electric. The primary performance objectives for Measure E1 are to: (1) electrify 25 percent of the existing residential buildings by 2030, 40 percent by 2035, and 80 percent by 2045; (2) electrify 15 percent of the existing nonresidential buildings by 2030, 25 percent by 2035, and 60 percent by 2045; and (3) require zero net energy (ZNE) for 50 percent of all major renovations by 2030, 75 percent by 2035, and 100 percent by 2045.
extraction_rationale: This measure sets quantified building electrification and ZNE targets.

parent_statement: Measure E1: Transition Existing Buildings to All-Electric
policy_statement: Adopt building performance standards and reach codes for major retrofits requiring electric water and space heating and point-of-sale retrofits.
source_quote: Action E1.1 Adopt Building Performance Standards for existing buildings and reach code requirements for major retrofits and renovations that require electric water and space heating. Require buildings to retrofit natural gas water and space heating to electric water and space heating at the point of sale.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding building performance and retrofit requirement for electrification.

parent_statement: Measure E1: Transition Existing Buildings to All-Electric
policy_statement: Increase alternatives to natural gas in existing buildings and establish carbon intensity limits for large buildings.
source_quote: Action E1.2 Increase alternatives to natural gas uses, such as for cooking, in existing buildings. Establish carbon intensity limits for existing nonresidential and residential buildings over a certain size.
extraction_rationale: This is a regulatory building decarbonization action using carbon intensity limits.

parent_statement: Measure E1: Transition Existing Buildings to All-Electric
policy_statement: Adopt a ZNE ordinance for certain building renovations and ZNE building performance standards for certain existing buildings.
source_quote: Action E1.3 Adopt a ZNE ordinance for building renovations, based on certain criteria (such as commercial facilities with 10,000 square feet of additions). Adopt ZNE Building Performance Standards for certain buildings not undergoing major renovations or retrofits.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding ordinance and performance standard for zero net energy buildings.

parent_statement: Measure E1: Transition Existing Buildings to All-Electric
policy_statement: Create a phased electrification plan for County facilities and phase out gas-powered infrastructure and appliances as replaced.
source_quote: Action E1.4 Create a plan for phased electrification of County facilities. Phase out gas-powered infrastructure and appliances as they need replacement.
extraction_rationale: This is an operational municipal building decarbonization plan.

parent_statement: Measure E1: Transition Existing Buildings to All-Electric
policy_statement: Create a fund aggregation program supporting energy efficiency, decarbonization, and resilience in new and existing affordable housing.
source_quote: Action E1.5 Create a comprehensive fund aggregation program to support energy efficiency, decarbonization, and resilience in new and existing affordable housing.
extraction_rationale: This is a financial instrument for building efficiency, decarbonization, and resilience.

parent_statement: Measure E1: Transition Existing Buildings to All-Electric
policy_statement: Create an energy retrofit accelerator providing technical support, training, and funding access for building owners and contractors, targeting low-income communities and affordable housing.
source_quote: Action E1.6 Create an energy retrofit accelerator to provide a one-stop shop for guidance, technical support, training, and access to aggregated funds to support building owners and contractors. Target support to low-income communities and affordable housing.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific program supporting retrofits and access to funds for building decarbonization.

policy_statement: Standardize all-electric new development and require most new buildings to be ZNE by 2030.
source_quote: Measure E2: Standardize All-Electric New Development. The performance objectives for Measure E2 are to: (1) require that all applicable new buildings are all-electric (taking into consideration the varying climate, geography, infrastructure, and sole-source dependency challenges that rural communities and unique industries may face), such that 90 percent of new residential and nonresidential buildings are all-electric by 2030, 95 percent by 2035, and 100 percent by 2045; and (2) require that all applicable new residential and nonresidential buildings are ZNE, such that 90 percent of new residential and nonresidential are ZNE by in 2030.
extraction_rationale: This measure sets quantified all-electric and zero net energy requirements for new buildings.

parent_statement: Measure E2: Standardize All-Electric New Development
policy_statement: Adopt an ordinance requiring applicable new buildings to be fully electric with no natural gas hookups, with affordability support.
source_quote: Action E2.1 Adopt an ordinance requiring all applicable new buildings to be fully electric with no natural gas hookups. Include affordable housing considerations in these requirements, and develop supporting measures (financial support, technical assistance, or other incentives) to defray potential additional first costs in order to maintain housing affordability.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding building electrification ordinance with supporting affordability measures.

parent_statement: Measure E2: Standardize All-Electric New Development
policy_statement: Adopt a ZNE ordinance for new residential buildings after 2025 and new nonresidential buildings after 2030, with renter protections and affordable housing set-asides.
source_quote: Action E2.2 Adopt a ZNE ordinance for all new residential buildings built after 2025 and all new nonresidential buildings built after 2030. Include renter protections for affordable housing. Provide affordable housing set-aside to offset first cost.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding zero net energy building ordinance with dates and affordability protections.

parent_statement: Measure E2: Standardize All-Electric New Development
policy_statement: Adopt CALGreen Tier 1 green building standards and identify Tier 2 standards for possible code amendments.
source_quote: Action E2.3 Adopt CALGreen Code Tier 1 green building standards and identify which Tier 2 standards could be adopted as code amendments.
extraction_rationale: This is a building code adoption commitment for green building standards.

policy_statement: Implement other building decarbonization actions including biomethane in gas supply, low-carbon concrete, and low-GWP refrigerant replacement.
source_quote: Measure E3: Implement Other Decarbonization Actions. The performance objectives of Measure E3 are to: (1) increase the proportion of biomethane in the utility natural gas mix to 20 percent by 2030, 30 percent by 2035, and 80 percent by 2045; (2) use low-carbon, carbon-neutral, or negative-carbon concrete for all new construction; and (3) replace high-global-warming-potential refrigerants with lowglobal-warming-potential refrigerants 15 percent by 2030, 25 percent by 2035, and 50 percent by 2045.
extraction_rationale: This measure has quantified decarbonization targets for gas supply, materials, and refrigerants.

parent_statement: Measure E3: Implement Other Decarbonization Actions
policy_statement: Work with utilities to increase biomethane in the natural gas mix.
source_quote: Action E3.1 Work with utilities to incorporate increasing levels of biomethane into the natural gas mix.
extraction_rationale: This is a low-carbon fuel supply action for building energy.

parent_statement: Measure E3: Implement Other Decarbonization Actions
policy_statement: Adopt a concrete code limiting embodied carbon emissions in new construction.
source_quote: Action E3.2 Adopt a concrete code for new construction that limits embodied carbon emissions; specify code requirements of carbon intensity limit for concrete.
extraction_rationale: This is a building/materials code action directly regulating embodied carbon.

parent_statement: Measure E3: Implement Other Decarbonization Actions
policy_statement: Adopt reach code requirements with performance standards limiting embodied carbon associated with construction.
source_quote: Action E3.3 Adopt reach code requirements that include performance standards to limit the amount of embodied carbon associated with construction.
extraction_rationale: This is a code-based embodied carbon performance standard.

parent_statement: Measure E3: Implement Other Decarbonization Actions
policy_statement: Develop a refrigerant management program phasing out high-GWP refrigerants and requiring low-GWP refrigerants in new development.
source_quote: Action E3.4 Develop a refrigerant management program that establishes a phase-out timeline for high-GWP refrigerants in existing buildings, incentivizes industrial equipment replacement, and specifies requirements for new development to use low-GWP refrigerants.
extraction_rationale: This is a named program with phase-out timelines, incentives, and requirements targeting high-GWP gases.

policy_statement: Improve energy efficiency of existing buildings by reducing energy use intensity below 2015 levels through 2045.
source_quote: Measure E4: Improve Energy Efficiency of Existing Buildings. The performance objective of Measure E4 is to reduce building Energy Use Intensity (thousand British thermal units per square foot) below 2015 levels by 20 percent for residential, 15 percent for industrial, and 25 percent for commercial by 2030; 25 percent for residential and industrial and 35 percent for commercial by 2035; and 50 percent for residential, industrial, and commercial by 2045.
section_header: 2.6.2.6 Strategy 6: Improve Efficiency of Existing Building Energy Use
extraction_rationale: This measure sets quantified energy efficiency targets by sector and deadline.

parent_statement: Measure E4: Improve Energy Efficiency of Existing Buildings
policy_statement: Adopt energy efficiency building performance standards requiring retrofits at point of sale and expand SoCalREN efficiency programs with renter protections and support measures.
source_quote: Action E4.1 Adopt Building Performance Standards for energy efficiency in existing buildings. Require all buildings to perform energy efficiency retrofits at the point of sale. Expand and enhance the energy efficiency programs offered by the Southern California Regional Energy Network (SoCalREN). Include affordable housing considerations in these requirements, and develop additional renter protections and supporting measures (financial support, technical assistance, or other incentives) to limit the amount of first costs being passed on to low-income renters.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding building energy efficiency standard and retrofit requirement.

parent_statement: Measure E4: Improve Energy Efficiency of Existing Buildings
policy_statement: Adopt an energy efficiency ordinance requiring existing buildings over 20,000 square feet to benchmark, report, and demonstrate a pathway to efficiency.
source_quote: Action E4.2 Adopt an energy efficiency ordinance for existing buildings, requiring all buildings over 20,000 square feet to benchmark and report their energy use and demonstrate their pathway to efficiency.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding benchmarking/reporting ordinance for energy efficiency.

parent_statement: Measure E4: Improve Energy Efficiency of Existing Buildings
policy_statement: Convert existing County-owned heat-trapping surfaces to cool or green surfaces.
source_quote: Action E4.3 Convert existing County-owned heat-trapping surfaces to cool or green surfaces.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific municipal surface conversion action; it addresses cooling and can improve building energy performance.

policy_statement: Increase use of recycled water, gray water, and potable reuse to meet 90 percent of total water demand by 2045 and high shares of agricultural and industrial demand.
source_quote: Measure E5: Increase Use of Recycled Water and Gray Water Systems. The performance objectives of Measure E5 are to: (1) meet 25 percent of total unincorporated Los Angeles County water demand with recycled water, gray water, or potable reuse by 2025, 50 percent by 2030, and 90 percent by 2045; (2) meet 30 percent of water demand for agricultural and industrial uses with recycled water or gray water by 2025, 50 percent by 2030, and 80 percent by 2045; and (3) implement a successful direct potable reuse project by 2025.
extraction_rationale: This measure sets quantified water reuse targets and a direct potable reuse project deadline.

parent_statement: Measure E5: Increase Use of Recycled Water and Gray Water Systems
policy_statement: Require dual waste piping in new residential developments to allow future graywater irrigation systems.
source_quote: Action E5.1 Require dual waste piping to be installed in new residential developments to allow for future graywater irrigation systems.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific building/plumbing requirement enabling graywater reuse.

parent_statement: Measure E5: Increase Use of Recycled Water and Gray Water Systems
policy_statement: Require recycled water and gray water for agricultural purposes where available and identify soil and water conservation BMPs.
source_quote: Action E5.2 Require the use of recycled water and gray water for agricultural purposes where recycled water is available. Identify soil and water conservation best practices for agricultural uses. Work with LACSD and other water suppliers to assess the feasibility of new recycled water facilities for unserved communities.
extraction_rationale: This is a water reuse requirement and conservation BMP action for agriculture.

parent_statement: Measure E5: Increase Use of Recycled Water and Gray Water Systems
policy_statement: Require recycled water and gray water for industrial purposes where available and identify industrial water conservation BMPs.
source_quote: Action E5.3 Require the use of recycled water and gray water for industrial purposes where recycled water is available. Identify water conservation best practices for industrial uses. Work with LACSD and other water suppliers to assess the feasibility of new recycled water facilities for unserved communities.
extraction_rationale: This is a water reuse requirement and conservation BMP action for industry.

parent_statement: Measure E5: Increase Use of Recycled Water and Gray Water Systems
policy_statement: Require recycled water and gray water for landscape irrigation where recycled water is available.
source_quote: Action E5.4 Require the use of recycled water and gray water for landscaping irrigation purposes where recycled water is available.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific water reuse requirement for irrigation.

parent_statement: Measure E5: Increase Use of Recycled Water and Gray Water Systems
policy_statement: Partner with water districts and retail suppliers to explore widespread direct potable reuse through pilot projects.
source_quote: Action E5.5 Partner with the County water districts and retail suppliers to explore the potential for widespread utilization of direct potable reuse through pilot projects.
extraction_rationale: This is a pilot project commitment to expand water reuse.

policy_statement: Reduce indoor and outdoor water consumption to 85 gallons per capita per day by 2045, cut outdoor landscaping water use by 50 percent, and reduce municipal water consumption by 50 percent.
source_quote: Measure E6: Reduce Indoor and Outdoor Water Consumption. The performance objectives of Measure E6 are to: (1) reduce total water use to less than 110 gallons per capita per day (GPCD) by 2030, 100 GPCD by 2035, and 85 GPCD by 2045; (2) reduce outdoor landscaping water use to 10 percent by 2030, 20 percent by 2035, and 50 percent by 2045; and (3) reduce municipal water consumption 10 percent by 2030, 20 percent by 2035, and 50 percent by 2045.
extraction_rationale: This measure sets quantified water conservation targets and deadlines.

parent_statement: Measure E6: Reduce Indoor and Outdoor Water Consumption
policy_statement: Develop a water conservation ordinance for new public and private development using LEED or SITES standards.
source_quote: Action E6.1 Develop a water conservation ordinance for new development (public and private). Utilize Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) or Sustainable SITES Initiative (SITES) standards. A future ordinance may include a net-zero water requirement for new greenfield development.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding ordinance development action for new development water conservation.

parent_statement: Measure E6: Reduce Indoor and Outdoor Water Consumption
policy_statement: Adopt a water efficiency ordinance requiring existing buildings over 20,000 square feet to benchmark, report, and demonstrate a pathway to efficiency.
source_quote: Action E6.2 Adopt a water efficiency ordinance for existing buildings, requiring all buildings over 20,000 square feet to benchmark and report their water use and demonstrate their pathway to efficiency.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding water benchmarking and efficiency ordinance.

parent_statement: Measure E6: Reduce Indoor and Outdoor Water Consumption
policy_statement: Incentivize replacement of water-intensive landscaping with water-conserving landscaping or California native plants through ordinance, education, and incentives.
source_quote: Action E6.3 Incentivize residents to replace water-intensive landscaping, such as decorative turf, with water-conserving landscaping and/or California native plants through a new ordinance along with education and incentive programs.
extraction_rationale: This is a water conservation incentive and ordinance action using landscaping replacement; native plants add an ecological mechanism.

parent_statement: Measure E6: Reduce Indoor and Outdoor Water Consumption
policy_statement: Improve water efficiency and conservation at County facilities.
source_quote: Action E6.4 Implement strategies to improve water efficiency and increase water conservation at County facilities.
extraction_rationale: This is an operational municipal water conservation action.

parent_statement: Measure E6: Reduce Indoor and Outdoor Water Consumption
policy_statement: Integrate water programs into the County affordable housing preservation program to protect affordability and maintain fitness in a changing climate.
source_quote: Action E6.5 Integrate water related programs into the County's affordable housing preservation program to protect the housing affordability of units and to keep the units fit for their purpose in a changing climate.
extraction_rationale: This links water conservation programs to affordable housing preservation and climate fitness.

policy_statement: Institutionalize sustainable waste systems and practices to reach 85 percent diversion by 2030, 90 percent by 2035, and 95 percent by 2045.
source_quote: Measure W1: Institutionalize Sustainable Waste Systems and Practices. The performance objectives of Measure W1 are to: (1) increase the total unincorporated Los Angeles County waste diversion rate to 85 percent by 2030, 90 percent by 2035, and 95 percent by 2045; (2) reduce the disposal of single-use plastics in landfills; (3) increase the Construction and Demolition Ordinance to 70 percent diversion; and (4) increase the percentage of construction and demolition debris reused in new projects (private and public).
section_header: 2.6.2.8 Strategy 8: Minimize Waste and Recover Energy and Materials from the Waste Stream
extraction_rationale: This measure has quantified waste diversion and construction waste objectives.

parent_statement: Measure W1: Institutionalize Sustainable Waste Systems and Practices
policy_statement: Identify best practice waste pricing programs to reduce waste generation to the maximum extent feasible.
source_quote: Action W1.1 Identify best practice waste pricing programs to reduce waste generation to the maximum extent feasible, including but not limited to differential prices for waste based on amount generated in the residential sector and reforms to tipping rate structures.
extraction_rationale: This is a waste pricing financial instrument aimed at reducing waste generation.

parent_statement: Measure W1: Institutionalize Sustainable Waste Systems and Practices
policy_statement: Implement, enforce, and expand the single-use plastics ordinance and polystyrene ban to the maximum extent feasible.
source_quote: Action W1.2 Implement, enforce, and expand to the maximum extent feasible the single-use plastics ordinance and polystyrene ban.
extraction_rationale: This is a regulatory waste reduction ordinance implementation and expansion action.

parent_statement: Measure W1: Institutionalize Sustainable Waste Systems and Practices
policy_statement: Increase County construction and demolition debris diversion requirements and allow recycled construction materials in new projects.
source_quote: Action W1.3 Increase the diversion requirements in the County's Construction and Demolition Debris Ordinance and allow the use of recycled construction materials in new projects.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding ordinance change for construction material diversion and reuse.

policy_statement: Increase organic waste diversion to support Countywide waste diversion rate goals.
source_quote: Measure W2: Increase Organic Waste Diversion. The performance objectives of Measure W2 are to maximize organic waste diversion to support the unincorporated Los Angeles County's overall waste diversion rate goals identified in Measure W1.
section_header: 2.6.2.8 Strategy 8: Minimize Waste and Recover Energy and Materials from the Waste Stream
extraction_rationale: This is a named waste diversion measure that supports quantified diversion goals in Measure W1.

parent_statement: Measure W2: Increase Organic Waste Diversion
policy_statement: Require organic waste generators to properly manage organic waste under the Organic Waste Disposal Reduction Ordinance and expand landfill diversion practices.
source_quote: Action W2.1 Require organic waste generators to properly manage organic waste as per the Organic Waste Disposal Reduction Ordinance. Improve upon and expand existing practices and programs to minimize organic waste disposal in landfills.
extraction_rationale: This is a binding organic waste management requirement and program expansion.

parent_statement: Measure W2: Increase Organic Waste Diversion
policy_statement: Develop organic waste collection, management, and diversion programs for unincorporated communities and County operations, with contamination monitoring.
source_quote: Action W2.2 Develop organic waste collection, management, and diversion programs for constituents in unincorporated communities and all County operations; establish a contamination monitoring plan for organic waste programs.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific program development action for organic waste diversion.

parent_statement: Measure W2: Increase Organic Waste Diversion
policy_statement: Use anaerobic digestion capacity to generate vehicle fuel from diverted organic waste and develop a bioenergy strategy.
source_quote: Action W2.3 Collaborate with the LA County Sanitation Districts and other waste and wastewater service providers to utilize unused anaerobic digestion capacity of existing wastewater treatment plants and solid waste facilities to generate vehicle fuel (electricity and/or biomethane) from newly diverted organic waste. Develop a strategy for using bioenergy created from recycled organic waste.
extraction_rationale: This is a specific waste-to-energy intervention using diverted organic waste.

parent_statement: Measure W2: Increase Organic Waste Diversion
policy_statement: Provide regional leadership for organic waste processing capacity planning and infrastructure development.
source_quote: Action W2.4 Provide regional leadership for organic waste processing capacity planning and infrastructure development.
extraction_rationale: This is a planning and infrastructure development commitment for organic waste diversion.

parent_statement: Measure W2: Increase Organic Waste Diversion
policy_statement: Enhance and expand the Food DROP program to divert edible food from landfills and redistribute it to food insecure communities.
source_quote: Action W2.5 Enhance and expand the County's existing Food DROP food donation and redistribution program to divert edible food from landfills and make it available to food insecure communities.
extraction_rationale: This is a named food waste diversion program with social co-benefits.

policy_statement: Conserve carbon-sequestering wildlands and working lands, restore forest lands, and manage wildlands for wildfire risk reduction and carbon stock savings.
source_quote: Measure A1: Conserve Forests, Woodlands, Shrublands, Grasslands, Desert, and other Carbon-Sequestering Wildlands and Working Lands. The performance objectives of Measure A1 are to: (1) reduce the average annual amount of natural land converted for urbanized uses 25 percent by 2030 (53 hectares conserved annually), 50 percent by 2035 (106 hectares conserved annually), and 75 percent by 2045 (159 hectares conserved annually); (2) conserve and restore 2,000 acres of natural forest lands by 2030, 4,000 acres by 2035, and 6,000 acres by 2045; and (3) manage 10,000 acres of wildland for wildfire risk reduction and carbon stock savings by 2030, 20,000 acres by 2035, and 50,000 acres by 2045.
section_header: 2.6.2.9 Strategy 9: Conserve and Connect Wildlands and Working Lands

parent_statement: Measure A1: Conserve Forests, Woodlands, Shrublands, Grasslands, Desert, and other Carbon-Sequestering Wildlands and Working Lands

policy_statement: Support regenerative agriculture by reducing synthetic fertilizer use and increasing acres using cover crops and regenerative techniques.

policy_statement: Implement Luxor’s priority SECAP actions across transport, boats, residential buildings, tourism facilities and Governorate buildings.
